tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rten gsum bzhugs gnas dang bcas pa'i sgrub tshul dpal 'byor rgya mtsho bzhugs so/ /

na mo mañdzu shrī ye/ rten gsum bzhugs gnas dang bcas pa'i sgrub tshul rgyas par bshad pa dpal 'byor rgya mtsho zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshogs gnyis rta ljang bzhon pa la chags shing*// legs bshad tsha zer thigs pa'i gzhon nu ma/ /phan bde'i 'dab stong ge sar bzhad pa'i dpal/ /'jam mgon bla ma'i nyi mas dge legs mdzod/ /thub dbang kha ba'i rdul brtsegs legs 'ongs shing*/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i gting mtha' zad mi shes/ /mkhas mchog klu dbang kun gyis bsten pa'i gzhi/ /thub bstan rin chen 'byung gnas la phyag 'tshal/ /'gro 'di'i phun tshogs gang la rag las par/ /thub bstan gnas dang 'phel bar 'gyur ba'i thabs/ /dge 'dun sde dang rten gsum bzhengs pa'i tshul/ /mdo rgyud mkhas pa'i rjes 'brang 'dir bshad bya/ /'dir yang rig pa'i gnas lnga dag la mkhas par ma byas na| |'phags mchog gis kyang thams cad mkhyen nyid thob mi 'gyur/ /de lta bas na gzhan dag tshar bcad rjes bzung dang*/ /rang nyid kun shes bya phyir de la de brtson bya/ /zhes mdo sde rgyan las gsungs pa ltar/ spyir rig pa'i gnas lnga'i nang nas bzo rig pa'i gzhan rjes su bzung ba'i phyir mkhas par bya dgos pa dang*/ khyad par skye rgu'i phan bde rgyal ba'i bstan pa la rag las shing*/ de yang dkon mchog gsum gyi rten la rag las pas de dag gi bzhengs tshul shin tu gal che bas bshad par bya'o/ /'di la lnga/ legs par bzhengs pa'i phan yon/ gang gis bzhengs pa'i rgyu tshogs/ gang du bzhengs ba'i sa phyogs/ gang zhig bzhengs pa'i rten gsum/ ji ltar bzhengs pa'i cho ga'o/ /nga po ni/ lung rnam 'byed las/ kun dga' ra ba gtsug lag khang*// mal stan 'tsho ba nar ma dang*/ /glo bur nad pa nad g.yog dang*/ /zhes sogs rdzas las byung ba'i bsod nams kyi gtso bo dge 'dun gyi sde dang*/ gtsug lag khang dang*/ sku gzugs dang*/ glegs bam dang*/ mchod rten bzhengs pa rnams yin par gsungs shing gnas mal gyi gzhi dang gso sbyong gi gzhi las/

gtsug lag khang rtsig cing ri mo bri ba dang*/ mchod rten bzhengs tshul dang*/ sku gzugs kyi 'gro don mdzad tshul dang*/ dge 'dun bsdus nas bstan pa'i bya ba byed tshul rgyas par gsungs pa bzhin du/ sngon grub chen kam+bha las kyang grub pa thob nas bstan pa la gang phan gzigs pas/ dge 'dun gyi sde 'dzugs pa las lhag par med par gzigs nas rgyal por bsams bzhin du skye ba bzhes te/ bi kra ma la shī la'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa dang*/ jo bo chen pos kyang 'phags pa rnam grol sde la sogs pa'i rjes su zhugs te/ rgya gar du gtsug lag khang du ma'i gnyer khang mdzad cing*/ bod du ston pa rin po che la yang 'dus byas kyi dge rtsa la dge 'dun gyi gnas gzhi bzhengs pa las lhag pa med pas gnas gzhi gyis shig ces nan gyis gdams pas na 'di dag ni phan yon shin tu che ste| theg pa thun mong ba lugs kyis dkon mchog dang po gnyis sku gzugs la bya bar dus 'khor sogs nas gsungs shing*/ mdo du ma las kyang*/ sangs rgyas nyan thos kyi dge 'dun bye ba phrag du ma dang bcas pa la lo grangs dpag tu med par yo byad kyi bsnyen bkur byas pa las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs mtshon gang ba ring bsrel gyi snying po can zhig 'jim pa la bsgrubs pa bsod nams lhag pa sogs mang du gsungs shing*/ gsal rgyal gyi zhus pa'i mdo las/ thub pa'i mchod rten byed dam byed bcug pa/ /mya ngan 'joms dang lus kun grims pa dang*/ /rin chen mdzod mang 'jig rten gtso 'gyur zhing*// mi de dgra'i tshogs las rgyal bar 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi mchod rten rnams dang ni/ /sku gzugs rnams la rdul phran ci yod pa/ /de 'dra'i grangs de snyed kyi rgyal srid dang*/ /lha yul sa steng mi yis nges par 'thob/ /gzugs dang gzugs med khams kyi ting nge 'dzin/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i sa mchog kun myong nas/ /thog mar skye dang rga ba la sogs pa'i/

/sdug bsngal dang bral sangs rgyas go 'phang 'thob/ /'di na rgyal ba'i sku gzugs byed pa ni/ /gzugs bzang skal bzang yon tan nye bar ldan/ /de ni dbang po sbas dang nyi ma'i 'od// 'jig rten kun gyi mthong na dga' bar 'gyur/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gzugs bzhengs pa gang*/ /de yi lus ni dri ma med pa dang*/ /nad dang mya ngan 'jigs dang sdug bsngal bral/ /pad+ma'i nang bzhin 'jam dang yangs par 'gyur| |'di na rgyal ba'i sku gzugs byed pa gang*/ bran du mi 'gyur dbul po'i rang bzhin min/ /las byed ma yin skye ba dman par min/ /dbang po ma tshang min ste skyes mchog 'gyur/ /zhes sogs dang*/ spyan ras gzigasakyi mdo dang*| mar me 'bul ba'i mdo dang*/ mchod rten skor ba'i mtshan nyid la sogs pa rnams na rgyas par bzhugs shing*/ bslab btus kyi mjug na mdo du ma drangs nas rten bzhengs pa dang bzhengs zin pa la zhabs tog byed pa'i phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab par gsungs pa rnams dang*/ rgyud sde gong 'og kun tu bris sku sogs sgrub tshul dang*/ de dag gi phan yon rgyas par gsungs pa rnams blta bar bya'o/ khyad par sher phyin gyi glegs bam bzhengs pa dang*/ de byang chub sems dpa' la phul ba'i bsod nams ni brgyad stong pa'i mchod bstod bkur sti dang bsod nams rnam grangs kyi le'u na rgyas par bzhugs pa ltar rgyas 'bring gzhan dang bsdus pa tshigs su bcad par/ la las bde gshegs yongs su mya ngan 'das pa yis/ /zhes sogs nas/ mchod rten byas mchod bsod nams de ni char mi phod/ /ces dang*/ bzhi brgya par/ rin chen rang bzhin mchod rten ni// 'jig rten snyed mthong 'ga' byas pa/ /de bas sems can ga cig 'dul ba// mchog tu bkrabs par brjod pa yin/ /zhes gsungs shing*/ 'phags pa bsdud par| la las gaṅga'i klung gi bye snyed zhing rnams na/ /sems can ji snyed 'khod kun dgra bcom nyid btul bas/

/gang gi shes rab pha rol phyin 'di yig bris te| |sems can mchog la glegs byin bsod nams khyad par 'phags/ /zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs pa ltar/ sku gzugs ni gsung 'byon 'byon 'dra yang*/ glegs bam ni de las ldog pas mkhas pa la ltos na ni/ sku gzugs las kyang gsung rab bzhengs pa bstan pa'i rgyun la phan shing*/ mkhas rmongs spyi la ltos na ni/ lha sa'i jo bo rin po che lta bus 'gro don mdzad pa tsam glegs bam gyi byed pa dka' bas sku gzugs 'gro don che bar snang ngo*/ /des na phyogs gcig kho na la zhen nas gzhan la sdang smras byed pa spangs te/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'dzin pa la 'khor lo gsum gyi bya ba sgo du ma nas khyad med du dgos par shes par bya la/ rang gi sgo gsum longs spyod kyi nus pa dang bstun/ dngos kyi yongs 'dzin gyis bzhed pa'i gtso bo rnams dngos su bsgrub cing*/ dngos su ma grub pa'i dge legs kyi bya ba gzhan la smon pa'i gnas dang*/ gang zag gzhan gyis bsgrubs pa mthong zhing thos pa dag la bsams pa thag pa nas rjes su yi rang bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa la rgyu'i yan lag sbyin bdag rkyen gyi yan lag bzo'o/ /de gnyis 'tshogs pa'i yo byad do/ /dang po la/ skyon gyi mtshan nyid ni/ sdig la mi 'dzem dad 'dun chung*// phan yon ma mthong yid mi ches/ /sgrub blo med pa'am yod na yang*/ /tshe 'di'i lo 'dod grags 'dod phyir/ /rkyen dang mi 'tsham blo rgya byed/ /ngang thung blo dwogs bzod sran chung*/ /lha dang bzo bo dmod byed cing*/ /'gyod pa skyes nas 'phro 'jog pa'o/ /yon tan gyi mtshan nyid ni/ phan yon mthong ba'i shes rab can// rtse gcig sems pa'i bsam gtan can/ /brtan zhing spro ba'i brtson 'grus can| |ngang ring tshig 'jam tshul khrims can/ /g.yo med gtong phod sbyin par ldan| |lha dang bzo bor dad gus ldan/ /rim gyi dga' spro bsgom pa'o/ / gnyis pa bzo bo'i skyon gyi mtshan nyid ni/

yon tan mi mkhas nga rgyal che| |'grogs pa mi bde bkur sti 'dod/ /'phral du tshig rtsub phugs 'dod che| |yon rgyags gla thang tshad med 'bebs/ /des kyang ma tshim rgyu cha rku/ /cung zad tsam la bzo 'phro 'jog /'gro sdigs byed cing chang nag 'tshol/ /dge las sdig par bsgyur mkhan yin/ /bzo bo'i yon tan gyi mtshan nyid ni/ rgyud sam+bu ṭi las| dul zhing dad ldan lang tshor bab/ /dbang po rnam gsal rnam rtog med/ khro med lkog 'phyas mi byed cing*/ /shin tu mkhas la spro ba che/ /bzod ldan snying rje chen po can/ ces dang*/ rgyud sdom 'byung las/ dul zhing bzo rnams kun shes la/ /cho ga mthong zhing mnyam gzhag pas/ /zhes dang*/ rgyud sde du ma nas gsungs pa'i yon tan spyi dang*/ sngags sku rnams la dbang thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa dang*/ rab dge slong sogs dang*/ tha ma'ang bzo 'dzugs dus bsnyen gnas blangs pa'i sdom ldan dgos par gsungs te/ 'dod pa chung zhing bkur sti sla/ /mkhas shing khengs med kha la mnyan/ /bzo la bzab cing rkyen ngan bzod/ /lha la gus shing spyod pa legs pa'o/ /yon bdag rgyu la mi bzab pa'i/ /'bras bu bzang 'dod ltas ngan yin/ /bzo bo lag cha mi bzab pa'i// bzo la bzob 'dod ltas ngan yin/ /zhes bya ba yin pas/ rgyu rab rin po che mchog tu gyur pa dang*/ gser dang*/ dngul dang*/ zangs dang*/ ra gan dang*| li la sogs pa dang/ gser dngul ljang brdungs kyi shog bu'am mthing shog ma mtha' shog skya gang bzang yan chad shing dang sa rdo sogs kyang gang bzang dang spus gang dag mi 'grub pa'i blo rgyar ma song tsam gyi rtsal 'don ched gnyer byas nas g.yo sgyu med par gtad cing*/ dang po nas lhus things pa gal che'o/ /bzo bos kyang skabs der dgos pa'i rgyu cha gang 'grub 'tshol rogs bsher mal mkhas pa dang bzo rgyu'i go rim ma log pa dang skabs su bab pa'i lag cha la gsar bzo rnying bcos sla chos su ma song ba nan tan chen pos bsgrub cing dang por ha cang zhum ste g.yag shing rgyal sgor grags pa yang ma yin/

ha cang mthos te sbyin bdag brtson pa 'dor ba'i rgyur 'gor ba yang ma yin par phyogs phyogs nas pha rol po gang byed kyang rang nyid lus dang longs spyod la snying po len 'dod kyis kun nas blangs te phan tshun mthun pa gtso bor bsgrub par bya yi/ thog mtha' bar gsum du kha smras dang kha mchu'i sbyor ba mi bya'o// gnyis ka la dgos pa'i zhal bkod pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen mdo sngags kyi bstan pa 'dzin pa 'chad par 'gyur ba'i sa phyogs dang*/ gnas dang rten gsum gyi mtshan nyid la mkhas pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid yongs su rdzaugs pa sbyin bdag dang bzo bo gnyis ka'i mgo 'don zhing lag rjes kyis phyis 'byung ba'i legs dpe thub pa dge rtsa thams cad rdzogs byang gi rgyur sbyor ba la mkhas pa nan tan gyis btsal zhing bsten par bya'o/ / gsum pa ni/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i phun sum tshogs pa thams cad phyi nang gi rten 'brel khyad du ma :sad [ bsad ] cing legs par bsgrigs pa las 'byung bas/ rgyud sde rnams las dkyil 'khor dang de'i khang pa gang du btsal bar gsung shing de yang sgo du ma nas brtag pa'i thabs gsungs pa ltar jo bo chen po la sogs pa'i mkhas pa rnams kyis kyang sa dpyad kyi rnam par bzhag pa mang du mdzad pa rnams las btus nas sa phyogs brtag cing blang dor la mkhas par bya ba yin te/ mthong ba dang reg pas skyon dang yon tan bskyed pa'i dug sbrul dang nor bu la sogs pa bzhin du nyes dmigs dang phan yon shin tu che ba'i phyir ro/ / de yang sngon byung gi lo rgyus thos pas brtag da ltar gyi snang tshul mthong bas brtag pa'o/ / dang po ni/ thun mong ba sangs rgyas kyis mdzad pa bcu gnyis la sogs pa bstan pa'i gnas sam/ sher phyin bshad pa'i sa phyogs lta bu rten gyi yul mchod pa'i gnas su gyur pa dang*/ gang zag khyad par can gyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas dang chos ldan gyi bya ba khyad par can 'byung bzhin pa'am/

sngon byung nas re shig rgyun chad pa'am rung ste/ bya ba mi shes pas bar du ma chod par bkra shis pa'i gnas su grags shing grub pa dang*/ thun mong min pa rdo rje theg pa sgrub pa'i gnas su byed na| 'dzam gling gnas mchog nyi shu rtsa bzhi'am yul so gnyis kyi nang du gtogs pa la sogs pa yid ches pa'i lo rgyus tshad mar byas te legs par gtan la 'bebs pa'i gnas rnyed na/ phyi'i sa dpyad brtag pa la sogs pa mi shes pa'am ma grub kyang dge legs ngang gis 'byung la| khyad par gnas chen gyi phan yon la yid ches pa'i dad mos yod na rten 'brel rang 'grig du 'gro'o/ /spyir yang bya ba gang byed bla ma dkon mchog la blo legs par bkal/ khyad par skabs su gang bab kyi mchod gtor la sogs pa sngon du 'gro bas legs par grub pa dang nyes pa bzlog pa'i don du gsol ba drag tu btab nas bstan pa dang sems can gyi don du lhag bsam dag pas zhugs na/ mo dang phywa dang rtsis la sogs pa'i dgos pa thams cad zhor la 'byung bas lam gyi rtsa ba dad pa dang*/ des kun nas blangs pa'i skyabs 'gro dang*/ de'i bslab bya thams cad gong 'phel du 'gyur bas legs par 'dod cing nyes pa mi 'dod pa'i blo sna nam skyes dus bla ma dkon mchog la gsol ba 'debs shing de'i don du dge ba gang 'grub la 'bad pa gtso bor bya zhing de ltar byed pa'i ngang nas legs par shes pa'i rtsis dang dpyad la sogs pa la yang blang dor du bya yi/ gtso bor bya rgyu dor nas phywa dang mo rtsis 'ba' zhig dang du len pa ni las 'bras khyad du bsod pa'am lta ngan gyi 'dres yod pas spang bar bya'o/ / gnyis pa ni/ yul ni dge bcu tshang ba ste/ khang sa zhing sa sa yi dge/ 'thung chu zhing chu chu yi dge /gam 'brog rgyang 'brog rtswa yi dge khang shing 'bud shing shing gi dge khang rdo 'thag rdo rdo yi dge /gnyis tshan 'di dag gcig yod par| |gcig shos yod pa dkon pas na/

/sngon tshe dkon pa rje gung gis// btsal bas la stod ya changs la/ /dang po brgyad po tshang bar mthong*/ /dpyad kyi gtso bo byang bskyab cing*/ /lho la mdun bstan lho nub gzhol/ /rgyab ri nye zhing mtho ba dang*/ /mdun ri ring zhing dma' ba dang*/ /nyi ma 'char snga rgas pa 'phyi// chu rgyun g.yas su 'bab pa rnams/ /kun tshang dpal ldan sa skya sogs/ /re re tsam las med par grags/ /sa dpyad thog mar sa yi mdun rgyab dang*// gdags sribs legs par shes pa shin tu gces/ /shar dang lho mdun gzhan gnyis rgyab tu 'dod/ /'on kyang rang rang lung pa'i gshis la sogs/ /gang du kha bltas shar du byas la brtsi/ /lho dang shar gdags gzhan gnyis sribs su 'dod| |sa la pho mo 'dir ltar 'dod/ /gyong rtsub rdo ba mang ba pho/ /'jam mnyen rdo nyung chu mang mo/ /mdog la brtag pa 'di lta ste/ /dkar dmar nag dang 'dres pa la/ /lha btsan bdud dang 'dre rnams gnas/ /sngo smug rin chen nor gyi dpyad/ /mdangs gsal snum chags za 'og bkram/ /gser g.yu rgyus 'dra mar khu'i snod/ /rgya zhau snyal 'dra ngur pa'i rgyab/ /stag lpags rma bya'i mdongs kyi mdog /zho brod bkal 'dra gcan gzan spu/ /me tog lug mig lta bu bzang*/ /ri la rgyal blon btsun mo'i ri/ /rtse mtho sked pa brjid pa lhun// rgyab gzar mdun bsnyel thu ba bskyor/ /srab 'thub ya yo med par brtan/ /rtse na gangs g.ya' spang nags 'dzom/ /mdun na chu dang ri yis bskor/ /g.yas brag g.yon chu zur na srubs/ /me tog bsung chags gong mo rgod/ /de 'dra ri yi rgyal po yin/ /bzang po'i ri rgyud bar ma chad/ /lho byang gzhung tshugs rtse mo mtho| |ri bran dral bcam bza' 'go 'dra/ /shing mang gcan gzan bya rgod gnas| |de 'dra ri yi blon po yin/ /ri stod 'od 'bar smad na chu/ /de ris mtha' bskor thu ba bskyor/ /'ja' 'od rin chen bstar brgyus 'dra/ /ngos 'jam ba tsha zug rngu med/

/de 'dra ri yi btsun mo yin/ /de gsum mdun du gnas 'debs shin tu bzang*/ /srog chags rdzas kyi 'dra gzugs ni/ /mi ltar 'grengs la 'dug pa dang*/ /nyal dang 'bros dang bsnyel ba lnga/ /dang po gnyis ni rab dang 'bring*/ /gsum pas nad 'byung gzhan gnyis ngan/ /phyugs ltar 'dug dang nya ltar 'phyo/ /bya ltar 'dug pa rnams kyang 'bring*/ /rdzas gzugs nor bu rdor dril sogs/ /bzang zhing dug sbrul la sogs ngan/ /'dra gzugs 'dres na'ang bzang ngan 'dres/ /sa la bzang dpyad lha bzhi dang*/ /ya rabs lnga ni yon tan dang*/ /phyug dang mdzes dang snying po'i sa/ /re re'ang drug drug slu yar brgyad/ /'dod pa brgyad dang yon tan brgyad/ /gang ba brgyad dang bzhad stangs brgyad/ /so sor gces dgu bzang po bcu/ /gdab 'os pa dang mi thub pa| |nyi shu nyi shu sa yi rigs/ /bzang po drug cu rtsa gsum dang*/ /nor nyen nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang*/ /grog po chu dang shing gi dpyad/ /la sogs mkhas pas shes bya ste/ /lha bzhi shar lho nub byang du/ /stag skya bya dmar 'brug sngon po/ /rus sbal ser po zhes byar grags/ /lam dang shing mtsho brag ri'o/ /stag la sa mda' zug pa dang*/ /bya la dbul brnyis zin pa dang*/ /'brug la thag gis 'thag pa dang*/ /rus sbal tsha bas thebs rnams ngan/ /lam la lam gzhan zug pa dang*/ /nags bar g.ya' yis bcad pa dang*/ /chu bar chu yis chod pa dang*// brag ri gas shing grum pa'o/ /lha bzhi gnas dang nye ring tshad/ /gom pa sum cu drug cu dang*/ /dgu bcu rab 'bring tha ma yin/ /ya rabs lnga ni them skas dang*// brum gcig rgyal po gdan la bzhugs/ /gser dril g.yu yi maṇ+ḍal 'dra/ /yon tan sa ni pad ze dang*/ /ut+pal rin chen ljon shing rgyas/ /chos sgrigs mar me 'bar 'dra'o/ /phyug btsan mtsho lud zhag 'khyil dang*/ /brungs gcer lto tshil mar khu'i snod/ /ba lang mkhal khung lta bu'o/ /mdzes pa rgyal pad blon po'i lkog

|maṇ+ḍal dbul dang ne tso'i lce/ /par pu'am mtsho yi snying po 'dra/ /snying sa mar spungs yar bzed dang*/ /sa srubs ri srubs med pa'o/ /dmu yad brgyad ni mkhal khung dang*/ /nu 'bur phyag rgya bsnol 'dra dang*/ /stag 'dzom rnga mo'i nog 'dra dang*/ /mar skyug lug gi dom bal dang*/ /brang zhol rgyas pa lta bu'o// 'dod brgyad rtse mo gnam la bsnyegs/ /sked pa brjid chags thu ba gdengs// rgyab ri mchongs 'dra mdun ri dma'/ /phyogs mtshams skyob cing nags shing rgyas| |gtsang po rgya mtsho mthong ba'o/ /yon tan rin chen brgyus 'dra dang*// dbus skyob mtha' bsdud thu ba brkyangs/ /za 'og bkrams 'dra gru bzhir mngon| |rgya rdo brtsegs 'dra shang shong med/ /mgo lus ma bral ba tshwa med// gang brgyad mtsho 'khyil ri bo sbom/ /sha brang bzhag rgyangs mchin btsos 'dra// me long ngos dang kha sbyar bse/ /tshags sbur bsags rnams 'dra ba'o/ /bzhad brgyad rang ri mdog snum mtho/ /gzhan ri kun zhom dgra ri bros/ /rang phyogs kun 'dud shing thog rgyas/ /sribs grum mdun phyug na mtha' yangs/ /gces dgu nam mkha' gru bzhi dang*/ /gangs ri la thod g.ya' ri smug /brag ri 'khar stabs spang ri smug /nags ri swo 'dra yol ri ber/ /lu ma na lung mig 'dra'o// bzang bcu dpal be sgraun me 'bar/ /mkhal brtsegs thung gcer rgyal mtshan sgraing*| |dar brkyangs bum pa mchod rten brtsegs/ /pho ltar sgeg dang na chung ltar| |brgyan pa bcu tshang don kun 'grub/ /gdab par 'os pa nyi shu ni/ /lha dang 'dra ba'i thugs kar gdab/ /rgyal mtshan 'dra ba'i rtsa ba'i cha/ /dpal dang dbus dang rgyal po'i khri/ /blon po'i 'jam stan btsun mo'i lte/ /skyes pa'i sta zur na chung ldeng*/ /mchod rten bang rim stag gi 'dzum/ /seṅge glang chen 'brug dang rta'i/ /mkhal khung g.yon dang sbrul gyi lto/ khyung snying 'brong mjing rma bya'i mdongs| |rnga mo'i nog dang nya 'dra'i lkog

/'di dag thub pa shin tu bzang*// lha yi cod pan rgyal mtshan rtse/ /mchod rten bum pa rgyal po'i thod/ /la sogs mi thub nyi shur spangs/ /pi waṃ brgyus 'dra rin po che/ /spungs 'dra la sogs drug cu gsum/ /rgyal po mkhar stabs 'gying 'dra dang*/ /sprang po dbyug thogs rgyug 'dra sogs/ /nor nyin nyi shu rtsa brgyad yod/ /rgyas par gzhan du blta bar gyis| |ngam 'brog phal cher ngan na yang*/ /brog rtse la khar phyi nang gyes/ /lug dang sran ma bkrams pa yis/ /bud kyis brog sgor spungs pa dang*/ /drang po btsug 'dra rtsa ba ni/ /lam dang nags dang na chus chod/ /mgo lnga shing lo 'dra ba dang*| |ut+pal rma bya'i mdongs 'dra bzang*/ /chu la'ang mdur rgyug 'bru chad dang*| |dal brjid smra lkug la sogs dang*/ /bzang ngan chu rigs bcu gnyis bshad| |shing la'ang nags chen 'thug pa dang*/ /skye legs 'gab tu 'byung ba dang*| |shing chen shing phran mang po yis/ /legs par bskor na bzang ba sogs| |phal cher rang gis dpyad pas shes/ /'di dag bzang dpyad mdor bsdus te/ /ngan dpyad phal cher ldog pas shes/ /gzhan ni sa dgra bcos pa'i thabs| |skabs su 'og tu bshad par bya/ /bzang dpyad shes nas gdab pa ni| |gdab 'os nyi shur bshad pa dang*/ /pad sdong ut+pal gyes mtshams dang*// rdo rje'i 'chang bzung dril bu'i sgyer/ /ba dan lce mtshams 'phan gyi dbus// mkhar spel ba gam ljon shing rtsa/ /gzhu 'gag nya shul sha pho'i brang*/ /lug gi dom bal bya rgod mgo /rus sbal lkog ma dpal be'i rwa/ /gos dang 'phying ba'i gong pa la/ /brungs dang nas mig de bzhin ni/ /lug khyung 'dra ba'i dbus su gdab| |mthon po'i ri la sked par bzang*/ /sgang dang gzar po'i bde sa dang*| |skyongs kyi 'bur sa 'bur gyi skyong*/ /g.ya' dang spang gi skam bsher mtshams| |na dang zhing gi thang gi dbus/ /'jam po'i rtsub pa rtsub po'i 'jam| |de yang skabs kyi 'dod dang sbyar/

/nor 'dod nags la rtsal 'dod brag |rta dang lug dang spu 'dod na/ /lam dang zhing dang spang la gdab/ /rgyal sa dpa' bo bu 'dod na/ /rgyal thugs btsun pang stag 'dzum la/ /tshe ring snyan pa bgrang thub 'dod/ /rdo rje dril bu po ti la/ /nor rdzas rje bo dgos dgu 'dod| |nags chen ut+pal rin chen dbus/ /mi nor zas bcud dgra 'dul 'dod| |glang chen sha pho seng ge'i ral/ /bshes gnyen bka' mnyan bkur sti 'dod| |dkyil 'khor dgod mgo zla tshe dbus/ kha drag gzhan bstod bang mdzod 'dod/ /rus sbal gzhung dang sgrom gyi dbus/ /mchod rten phal cher sgang du bzhengs/ /'on kyang grong sogs shar dang ni/ /chu mig mgo dang brog ral zug |sa mtshan yod dang sa rlan che/ /srog chags mang dang rgyu srang yod/ /grong dang gnyan sar grib ma 'bab/ /shar na chu bo res 'jog dang*/ /lho na shing skam yal ga med/ /nub na shing gcig kha khrag lam/ /byang na sa dgra mang ba'i sar// mchod rten gnas gzhi sogs mi bya/ /gzhan yang gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ /mtho dman snyoms shing gtsang la snum/ /zug rngu'i nyes pa rnam par spangs/ /shar dang byang de gzhol ba yi/ /sa gzhi las rnams kun la shis/ /zhes sogs dkyil chog du ma las/ /bshad pa thams cad 'dir 'dus so/ /rgyud dang dkyil chog rnams las shar dang byang dma' bar dgos par bshad pa ni/ 'jig rten spyi'i shar dang byang min gyi/ sa phyogs sam dkyil 'khor de nyid kyi mdun dang g.yon la bzhed pa yin no/ /gnas kyi yon tan gyi gtso bo ni/ dus 'khor rtsa rgyud las| gang na sa skyong chos ldan zhing*/ /skye rgu bder gnas rtsod pa med/ /ces gsungs pa ltar chos kyi rgyal pos legs par skyong zhing skye rgu bstan pa la dad pa dang 'byor pa che zhing rtsod pa med pa gal che ste/ mdo sde rgyan las/ blo ldan gang du bsgrub pa'i yul/ /legs par rnyed dang gnas bzang dang*/ /sa bzang ba dang grogs bzang dang*/

/rnal 'byor bde ba'i yon tan ldan/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ yo byad dang lus dang sems gnyis ka rnal 'byor rnams la mi gnod cing phan pa bsod snyoms btsal sla ba dang*/ chu bzang ba dang*/ gzhi bdag bzang ba dang*/ mthun pa'i grogs dang*/ nyin mo skye ba'i rgyu 'dugs dang*// mtshan mo'i klag col gyi sgra chung ba sogs te/ mthun pa'i yul la gnas pa zhes bya ba la/ rkyen 'khor lo chen po bzhi'i ya gyal cig yin pas/ gnas kyi mtshan nyid thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gsungs pa rnams legs par shes par bya ste blang dor la 'bad par gal che'o/ / bzhi pa gang zhig bzhengs pa'i rten gsum la dkon mchog gsum gyi'am/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten no/ /sangs rgyas kyi rten la chos sku/ longs sku/ sprul sku'i rten no/ / dang po ni/ mchod rten du grags shing*/ de la yang dbye ba lngar grags te| rang bzhin lhun grub kyi dang*/ bla na med pa'i dang*/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i dang*| dngos grub 'byung ba'i dang*/ theg pa so so'i mchod rten no/ / dang po la/ lung mchog bla ma zhes grags pa las/ gling bzhi rmang*/ gser ri ri rab dang bcas pa bang rim/ yongs 'du'i ljon shing bum par bshad pa phyi snod dang*/ kun gzhi rmang*/ rnam shes tshogs brgyad ka ba/ dbang po gzugs can bang rim/ yid dbang bum pa ste nang bcud mchod rten du bshad pa dang*| rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyus las/ 'dod khams dbang gi ri bo la/ /gzugs khams bang rim khri 'phang can/ /gzugs med bum rten bum par bcas/ /sku gdung chen po rgyun du gnas/ /zhes dang*/ smṛ ti'i de kho na nyid drug par/ sa yi khri 'phang zur bcu gnyis/ /gling bzhi gling phran brgyad yin te/ /bang rim bdun du brtsegs pa ni/ /gser gyi ri bdun shes par bya/ /dril bu'i dbyibs kyi bum pa ni/ /lha gnas ri rab yin zhes bya/ /bum rten 'khor lo gdub bu'i dbyibs| |klu'i rgyal po nor rgyas yin/

kha khyer rim pa drug ldan pa/ /'dod khams lha rigs drug tu grags/ /dbus su srog shing yar sgrengs pa/ /chos dbyings zag med spros bral yin/ /'khor lo bcu bdun gyis brgyan pa// gzugs khams gnas rigs bcu bdun rtags/ /char khebs gzugs med khams yin te/ /chos dbyings tog tu shes par bya/ /zhes snod bcud spyir mchod rten du bshad/ ces zer zhing*/ dus 'khor du/ dkyil 'khor bzhi po bang rim dang*/ ri rab bum pa dang*/ ri rab kyi mgrin pa dang*/ gdong man chad bre dang*| de yan dang skra chos 'khor char khebs kyi rnam par gsal ba bshad pa lta bu'o/ / gnyis pa ni/ tshad med bsam yas las byung 'bras/ /shar du byams pa rdo rje brtsegs/ /lhor la snying rje rin chen brtsegs/ /nub tu dga' ba pad+ma brtsegs| |byang du btang snyoms rgya gram brtsegs/ /rang byung rin chen snang ba'o/ /zhes pa shar du byams pa tshad med rdo rje du ma brtsegs pa la sogs pa bzhir thig le dbang gi rgyus ces bya ba las bshad do zhes grags so/ / gsum pa ni/ 'khor lo 'byung ba'i rgyud du grags pa las/ byin brlabs sku gdung cha brgyad gling bzhir snang*/ /zhes pa'i 'grel par/ shar lus 'phags na/ byams ldan bsod nams gter dang*/ mthar legs g.yung drung tog gnyis/ lho 'dzam bu gling na thugs rje sprul pa dang*/ yid bzhin lhun grub gnyis| nub ba lang spyod na dpe med bsam 'das dang*/ rmad grags chos dbyings gnyis/ byang sgra mi snyan na yon tan rin chen brtsegs dang*/ khams gsum bde rgyas sgron gyi mchod rten gnyis bzhugs par bshad do/ / bzhi pa ni/ bdud rtsi mchog gi rgyud las/ ro yi bsrung ma chen mo ni// ma mo chen mo brgyad bzhag go /de dag rten gnas chen mo yang*/ /mchod rten brgyad du rnam par bzhag /ces pa'i 'grel par/ sngon he ru kas drag po brtul ba'i tshe yul brgyad kyi dur khrod du ma mo brgyad kyi rten dngos grub 'byung ba'i mchod rten brgyad byung ba ni/
ma gha dhar bde byed/ bsil ba tshal du ro langs/ sing gha lar ri bo ta la/ bal por :bya khri kha bshor

[ bya rung kha shor ] / seng ge'i gling du ge'u do na/ li yul du go ma sa la ghan+dha/ kha cher ka na ka za hor du bde spyod gzhon nu'i mchod rten no/ lnga pa la/ nyan rang theg chen gyi gsum mo/ dang po ni/ chos gos bzhi ltab gyi steng du lhung bzed sbub pa la 'khar bsil btsugs pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rmang gru bzhi'i steng du ngos gru bzhi'am zlum po dang khang bu lta bu dang*/ rgyal mtshan lta bu'i mchod rten brgyad la sogs pa'o/ /'dul ba lung las ni/ chos 'khor la gdugs dang gdugs la char khebs su btags nas| so skye'i gdugs med pa'i byi bo/ nyan thos la 'bras bu'i grangs kyi gdugs| rang rgyal gyi gdugs bdun/ sangs rgyas kyi gdugs bcu gsum char khebs tog dang bcas pa rnam par thams cad par gsungs so/ /rgyud sde so so'i dbang du byas nas bya spyod kyi mchod rten bang rim nang du bcag cing phyir 'bur ba'am dbus 'bur la mtha' gnyis nang du bcums pa 'khor lo bcu gnyis la sogs pa'ang bshad par gragarnal 'byor rgyud kyi sngar bshad pa'i rdo rje brtsegs pa sogs bla med kyi dus 'khor nas gsungs pa sogs so/ khyad par las kyi mtha' brjod pa'i mdo las/ sprul pa mdzad pa sngon bstan phyir// mchod rten brgyad du sku gdung bzhag /ces bshad pa ltar/ dpal mgon klu sgrub kyis gnas brgyad kyi mchod rten la rnam gzhag dang bstod pa mdzad pa ltar| ston pa 'di'i mdzad pa khyad par can la brten nas yul ljongs de dang de'i skye bo spro ba skyes te/ dus ston bya ba'i phyir du brtsigs pa shākya thub pa'i mchod rten brgyad du grags pa ni/ dang po la gnas grong khyer ser skyar dus sku bltams pa'i tshe byung ba bde gshegs mchod rten du grags pa/ dbyibs bla ma dag zlum po pad+ma'i 'dab ma can bang rim bzhi pa'am bdun pa/ bltams pa'i mchod rten nam pad+ma'i 'dab ma can zhes zer gsung ba dang chos kyi 'khor lo la gru bzhi bang rim bzhi pa sgo bzhi'am brgyad la sogs pa gsungs yang*/

snga ma yang bkra shis 'byung ba'i mchod rten du 'phags pas gsungs pas kho bo ni de gnyis ldog par 'dod de/ gru bzhi bang rim bzhi pa glo 'bur dang bcas pa sgor rab brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ 'bring nga drug tha ma bcu drug pa'o/ / gnyis pa gnas rgyal po'i khab tu dus mngon par byang chub pa'i tshe byung ba byang chub chen por grags pa dbyibs gru bzhi bang rim bzhi pa'o/ / gsum pa gnas wa ra ṇa sī dus chos 'khor bskor ba'i tshe byung ba/ mtshan chos 'khor mchod rten nam/ ye shes mchod rten du grags pa/ zlum po bang rim bzhi pa'am bdun nam brgyad du'ang bshad pa pad+ma dang 'khor los spras pa'o/ / bzhi pa gnas mnyan yod dze ta'i tshal du/ dus cho 'phrul bstan pa'i tshe byung ba cho 'phrul chen po'am/ mu stegs pham mdzad du grags pa gru bzhi bang rim bzhi pa phyogs rer glo 'bur dang bcas pa'o/ / lnga pa gnas sum cu rtsa gsum du dbyar gnas mdzad/ yum la chos gsungs snga dro dgag dbye mdzad/ phyi dro mkha' la babs nas/ gsal ldan du phebs dus su byung ba/ bang rim bzhi pa'am/ brgyad pa ngos rer glo 'bur dang bcas pa'i glo 'bur gyi dbus na them skas yod pa lha babs sam/ sum cu lha'i mchod rten du grags pa'o/ / drug pa rgyal po'i khab tu lha byin gyi dge 'dun gyi dbyen byas pa/ mchog zung gis bsdums pa'i dus su byung ba/ dbyen bsdums sam 'od zer can nam/ byams ngos mchod rten du grags pa/ bang rim bzhi pa/ gru bzhi'i zur bzhi mnyam par bcad pa'o/ / bdun pa gnas yangs pa can du sku tshe zla ba gsum byin gyis brlabs pa'i tshe byung ba/ rnam rgyal lam/ byin brlabs mchod rten du grags pa/ zlum pau bang rim gsum pa'o/ / brgyad pa rtsa mchog gi grong du mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshe byung ba/ chos rgyal mya ngan med dam/ myang 'das mchod rten du grags pa/ bang rim med pa gdan khri'i steng du bum brten yan chad bzhugs pa'o/

/de la yang sku gdung cha brgyad du bgos pa'i mchod rten chen po brgyad/ ras tshig pa'i/ ma tshig pa'i/ sol ba'i mchod rten ste bcu gcig tshems sam mche ba lha dang srin pos khyer ba'i mchod rten/ phyis chos rgyal mya ngan med kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel bzhugs pa'i mchod rten bye ba dus gcig la bzhengs pa'i mchod rten sogs dang*/ mya ngan las ma 'das gong du dbu skra dang*/ sen mo'i mchod rten sogs dpag tu med de/ gtso bo snga ma brgyad du ci rigs par 'dus la/ deng sang yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel bzhugs na ni gang zag su'i ched du bzhengs kyang brgyad po gang rung gi rnam pa can rnam pa thams cad par bya dgos so| |de la yang dus 'khor sogs nas 'byung ba'i mgul pa thung ba'am/ dri med 'grel pa bshad pa'i mgrin ring sam/ rgyu dang bzo bo sogs kyis ji bzhin ma thon na/ ji ltar 'tsham zhing mdzes pa'ang bya rung zhing tshad ni 'og tu bshad par bya'o/ / gnyis pa/ longs sku'i rten la'ang rang bzhin lhun grub sogs ci rigs pa rgyud sde rnams las gsungs pa'ang shes par bya la/ bod na rgyal ba rigs lnga dang*/ nye ba'i sras brgyad sogs brgyan can la longs skur grags pa dang*| sprul sku kun la grags pa thun mong gi mchog gi sprul sku rab byung gi cha byad can la byed pa ltos nas grags pa ltar tha snyad byar rung mod kyi/ rgyud sdai nas gang bshad kyi dkyil 'khor kyi lha la sprul skus khyab pas na mtshan nyid du gzhag tu ni mi rung ngo*/ /des na longs sku dngos ni ngo bo ye shes kyi sku 'byung lus rags pa dang bral ba sa bcu'i byang sems las gzhan pa'i sems can la mi snang ba mtshan dpe'i cha shas phra zhing phra ba yang yongs su rdzogs pa snang ba nges pa can gzhi kha dog thams cad pa yin pa dkar po'am/ 'bras bu ye shes kyi rang mdog sngon po gang rung du nges pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis/

bla med kyi dbang du byas nas longs sku dang kha sbyor gyi yan lag sogs yan lag bdun du nges la| sprul sku ni gdul bya gang la gang 'dul gyi ngor 'byung bar grags pa'i mdog can zhal phyag du ma snang ba ma nges pa yin la/ phyag tshad kyi cha nas/ rang sor brgya nyer lnga pa longs sku'i sangs rgyas dang*/ de nas brgya bcu gnyis pa'i bar longs sku'i byang sems dang*/ de man chad sprul sku'i sangs rgyas byang sems te| sangs rgyas khrau bo'i cha byad can shin tu khros pa la ni rang sor lnga bcu yang bshad pa sogs su shes par bya'o/ /sprul sku yongs grags rab byung gi cha byad can ni/ dbu reg zhabs rjes gtsug tor dang ldan pa/ zhi zhing dul la mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba na bza' chos gos gsum pa/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung dang sku mdog ser pau shas che ba ste/ la la dmar po dang sngon po sogs kyang yin la zhabs bzhugs pa la phyag g.yon mnyam gzhag g.yas sa gnon/ mchog sbyin skyabs sbyin chos 'chad sogs dang*/ zhabs bzhengs stabs la phyag g.yon chos gos kyi dra 'dzin cing g.yas mchog sbyin skyabs sbyin gang rung dang glang po che nor skyong 'dul ba'i dang byin len gyi phyag rgya sogs kyang mthong ste mdor na mdo dang lung nas 'byung ba rgya gar mkhas pas bzhengs pa dag la brten nas rtogs par bya zhing*/ brgyan can zhal mang phyag mang sogs ni rgyud sde so so dang ma tha'ang de dag nas btus pa'i lha 'bum gsar rnying rnams las shes par bya ste/ 'dir mang gis dogs nas ma bris so/ /chos kyi rten gyi gtso bo ni po ti glegs bam ste/ mdo sde chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong*/ rgyud sde ni chos tshan sum khri sum stong du ye shes rdo rje kun las btus las bshad la/ pha rgyud bye ba khrag drug ma rgyud bye ba phrag bcu drugatheg pa thun mong gi mdo sde dung phyur brgyad/ sher phyin dung phyur lnga dang sa ya lngar bde mchog sdom 'byung du bshad cing*/

de dag gi dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa'o/ /thun mong min pa'i gsung gi rten ni/ dril bu dang bgrang 'phreng sogs so/ /dge 'dun la theg chen gyi dge 'dun sar gnas gyi byang sems ni/ 'jam dbyangs kyi zhing bkod lta bu la tshangs par spyod pa'i cha byad rab byung gi rnam pa'ang bshad cing*/ phal cher dbu skra zur phung lnga pa'am thor cog bcings pa'i na bza' dang*/ rgyan du mas brgyan pa rdo rje sems dpa'i skyil krung can gzhon nu'i cha lugs 'chang ba'o// nyan rang gi ni rab byung gi cha byad shin tu mdzes pa 'khar bsil lhung bzed dang po ti 'dzin pa'ang bya ste/ la la ni gtsug tor cung zad yo ba dang ldan pa'o/ /sku gsung thugs su dbye na/ zhal phyag gi rnam pa can dang*/ gtsug lag khang dang*/ mchod rten la sogs pa sku'i rten/ po ti bgrang 'phreng dril bu la sogs pa rol mo'i bye brag rnams gsung gi rten/ rdo rje gri gug la sogs phyag mtshan phal cher thugs kyi rten du bshad do/ / da ni cha tshad bshad pa la/ mchod rten gyi/ sku gzugs kyi/ phyag mtshan gyi/ gsung rab kyi tshad do/ / dang po la/ che chung gi tshad ni gang 'byor ste/ :kyu [ skyu ] ru ra'i 'bru tsam dang*/ dpag tshad mchod rten gyi rgya dpangs du ma bshad pas so/ /de yang 'byor na che yin bzang pas ches pa la skyon brjod pa dang*/ 'byor bzhin du skyung ba ni nyes dmigs shin tu che'o/ rgya dang dpangs ni/ rgyar dpag tshad tsam la 'phang du de'i phyed pa bshad la/ ngos bzhi sdoms pa'i brgyar 'dod pa'ang yod la| ngos re'i rgya yin kyang rgya ches drag pas 'phang du de'i phyed las slong mi thub pa la dgongs zhes kyang zer zhing*/ dkyil 'khor la mchod rten du bshad pa'ang mang bas dkyil 'khor gyi rgya phyed dpangs su bstan zhes kyang zer ro/ / de ltar na che chung gang byed kyang rang rang gi phyag tshad dang ldan pa dgos pas phyag tshad shes par bya la/ mchod rten yongs grags kyi dang*/

gzhal yas khang gi tshad do/ /dang po la dri med 'grel pa'i dang*/ dus 'khor gyi phyag tshad do/ / dang po ni/ rgyal ba gnyis med gsung de la/ /btud nas bde gshegs mchod rten tshad/ /dri med 'grel pa las gsungs pa/ /bde blag rtogs phyir bshad par bya/ /tshangs zur rtsa thig zur bzhi dang*/ /ngos rer cha chen bcu gnyis sogs/ /tshegs che don chung snang mod kyi/ kho bos ldog ste 'di skad smra/ /ji tsam 'byor pa'i tshangs thig gdab/ /smad nas seng khri ci mdzes bcad| |pad chen 'og thig bya ba'i phyir/ /tshangs thig gnyis pa 'debs lugs bya/ /yan chad phyed dang de phyed sogs/ /cha chen bcu gnyis ri mo bya/ pad chen rtsa nas tog rtse'i bar/ /mchod rten srid kyi tshad yin te/ /bre yi rten nam bum khebs kyi/ /rtsa ba'i mtshams ni phyed tshad yin/ /cha chen bzhi cha cha chung ste| |ma dang bu'i tha snyad bya/ /pad chen dpangs la cha phran gsum/ /dge ba'i rmang la cha phran gcig/bang rim bzhi po gnyis gnyis so/ /bum pa'i dpangs la cha chen gsum/ /'og nas bum gcig bum gdan bya/ /bum rtse phyed kyi tshad du sleb/ /bum khebs bum pa'i sum char 'dod/ /brai yi dpangs la cha phran gcig /gdong la gcig dang sum gnyis te/ /de stong pad+ma cha phran gcig/'khor lo bcu gsum mdo gzungs dang*/ /bcas pa bcu bdun byed rnams la// ha cang ring pas skyon 'byung bas/ /re re cha phran re rer bya/ /de yang chos 'khor bcu gsum po'i/ /steng du sum gnyis gdong dang ni/ /smad du sum cha rtseg bar bya| |bang rim bzhi po'ang de dang 'dra/ /thugs rje mdo gzung ut+pal bzhin// smad 'jam gdong kha cung zad gyes/ /de steng ka zhu rgya gram ni/ /cha phran phyed kyis dpangs dang ldan/ /de steng rtsibs brgyad sum cha'i dpangs/ /gdugs dang gdugs khebs sdoms pa la/ /cha phran gcig dang sum gnyis dpangs/ khro gdan la gcig tog la bzhi/ /pad chen 'og tu pad chung la/

/cha phran phyed kyi dpangs bya zhing*/ /seng khri'i smad kyi sum cha la/ /sa gdan ji ltar mdzes par bya/ da ni rgya tshad bshad kyis nyon/ /tshangs thig nas bcal pad chen gyi// srid la phyed dang bco lnga ste/ /rmang rten bcu gsum bang rim bzhi/ /cha phran re re nang du phri/ /bum gdan bum pa'i rtsa ba yang/ /de dang 'dra ba re re zhum/ /bum stod bang rim gsum pa dang*/ /'dra ba cha phran bcu yis thig /bum pa'i dbus bzung bskor bas 'grub/ /bum khebs pad kyis gzhal bar bya/ /bre la gcig ste bre gdong gnyis/ /pad+ma'i rtsa ba de dang 'dra/ /'dab rtse phyi la bu gcig gdengs| |chos 'khor dang po de dang mnyam/ /des ni de rgyu thig sna bzung*// bcu gsum pa yi tshangs thig nas/ /bcu bzhi bcal bar sna bzung nas/ /thig gdab 'khor lo'i gdong 'byung ste/ /de nang cha phran phyed bcums nas/ /skam thig gdab pas rtseg par 'byung*/ /ka zhu'i srid la cha phran gnyis/ /gdugs ni 'khor lo drug pa'i tshad/ /gdugs khebs drug pa dang mnyam zhing*/ /za ra tshags kyi rtsa ba ni/ /gdugs la sbyar bya bshang kha'i rgya/ /bre'i gdong dang mnyam par bshad/ /pad chung dang ni seng ge'i khri/ /nang du cha phran phyed phyed zhum// mchod rten dkar po seng khri ljang*/ /rmang rten ser po mdo gzungs dang*/ /za ra tshags sogs bkra ba dang*/ /'khor lo'i gdong ser rtseg bar dmar/ /gdong la rgyal ba'i sku sogs dang*/ /bar la rdo rje bya bar bshad/ /rtsibs bar rigs bzhi'i mtshan ma dang*/ /mtshams su yum bzhi'i mtshan ma'am/ /sa bon lañdzar bris na'ang legs/ /'di la lho byang brje ba sogs/ /mngon sum ltar snang gtsor gzung ba'i/ /blo bzo mi bya byas gyur na/ /'jig rten lho byang 'grig snang yang*| |gtso bo'i g.yas g.yon log par 'gyur/ /de las thar phyir gtso bo'i dbu| |shar la bstan na gtso bo'i mdun/ /nub la bstan phyir rgyab mdun ldog/de nas sa 'khor ji bzhin bya/

/rgyas par 'og tu bshad par bya/ /'di ni byang chub chen po ste/ /bang rim ma gtogs gzhan kun mtshungs/ /bang rim gsum pa bdun pa sogs/ /'di yi bang rim rgya dpangs kyi/ /sa la gsum dang bdun sogs 'god/ /myang 'das bang rim med pas na/ /seng khri mtho ba tshad mnyam bya| |glo bur byed pa rang rang gi /bre bskyed nang du zhum rnams skyungs/ /bum pa'i sbom pa cung zad gtod/ /rgya dang zheng du byas pas 'grub/ /glo 'bur seng khri la yang byed/ /chen po sa sogs la bzhengs na/ /bre skas nang du zhum rnams skyung*| |bum pa'i rnam pa cung zad stod/ /seng khri cung zad mtho na mdzes/ /ha cang ches na bre yi tshad/ /rtsa ba nyid nas 'gram slang zhing*/ /de phyir nang zlum phyi gru bzhi/ /bang rim bzhi pa'i phyi tshad dang*/ /bum pa'i nang tshad zhu 'drongs bcas| |nges par byas pa'i rdo 'gram la/ /nan tan bya ba shin tu gces/ /de lhag shun pa bzhin du slangs/ /seng khri'i ngos rer bug pa gsum/ /bang rim bzhi par re re yang*/ /bum pa'i ngos rer re re rnams/ /phyogs kun thal ba'i rlung bseng gces/ /bum gdan rtsa nas srog shing gzugs/ /gnod sbyin 'khor lo gzungs gzhug sogs/ /byed tshul 'og tu 'chad par bya/ /'di dag rab byung cha lugs kyis/ /gtso bo chos gos brgyad ltab steng*/ /lhung bzed 'khar gsil bzhag 'dra'o/ /'di rnams kyi rnam bzhag ni/ slob dpon shān+ti gar+bha'i mchod rten gyi cha dbye ba las/ pad ni rjes dran drug rmang rten ni dge ba bcu/ bang rim bzhi bum gdan/ bum pa bre rnams dran pa nyer bzhag nas/ 'phags lam yan lag brgyad kyi bar/ srog shing kun rdzaub shes pa la sogs pa'i shes pa bcu/ pad+ma thabs dang shes rab/ 'khor lo bcu gsum ni stobs bcu dang*/ dran pa nyer bzhag gsum/ char khebs thugs rje chen po/ tog ni chos sku/ mchod rten gyi 'khor la rdo :rengs

[ ring ] mi 'jigs pa bzhi/ them skas bsrung ba med pa/ rgyal mtshan bdud bzhi las rgyal ba/ me tog gi phreng ba mtshan dpe/ rgyal chen bzhi bden pa bzhi/ dril bu gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu/ nyi zla ye shes kyi snang ba bskyed pa/ me long ye shes bzhi/ cod pan chos kyi rgyal srid thob pa/ bad ni chos kyi snyan pas kun la grags pa byang chub chen po'o/ /sgo mang gi sgo ni/ bden bzhi rnam thar brgyad/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis/ stong nyid bcu drug la sogs pa'o/ /glo 'bur gzhan las khyad par 'phags pa sems can gyi don mdzad pa'o/ /lha babs kyi them skas ni/ sangs rgyas rnams sems can gyi don la 'byor par mtshon pa'o/ /myang 'das la bang rim med pa ni/ 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa dang bral zhing spros pa med pa'o/ /pad+ma can gyi pad+ma ni 'khor ba'i 'dam las skyes kyang des ma gos pa'o/ /dbyen 'dums zur bzhi bcas pa ni/ dbyen gyi rgyu dug gsum lta ba dang bzhi bcad nas/ rnam thar zad par zil gnon brgyad mtshon pa'o/ / gnyis pa dus 'khor nas 'byung ba ni/ sangs rgyas skyil krung du bzhugs pa'i lte ba man chad bang rim/ lte 'bur bum gdan/ de nas dpung pa'i bar bum pa/ mgrin pa bre kos ko nas sna rtse dang*/ de nas mdzod spu'i bar bre gdong*/ de nas ral pa'i thor cog gi bar zhal gang la chos 'khor char khebs tog dang bcas pa byed pa ste/ phyi 'jig rten gyi dkyil 'khor bzhi dang*/ ri rab kyi lus dang*/ mgrin pa/ gdong pa skra rnams dang*/ tshad gcig pas phyi nang gzhan gsum sbyor ba'o/ /rnam bzhag kyang de nyid yin pas tshigs bcad du brjod na/ dus kyi 'khor lo la btud nas/ /de nas gsungs pa'i mchod rten bshad| |ji ltar 'byor pa'i tshangs thig gdab/ /thig de dum bu lnga ru btub/ / lnga po re rer zhal re ste/ /sor mo phyed dang bcu gnyis pa/ /de lnga lus kyi gsang gnas nas/ /ya tha gtsug tor bar gyi ni/

/rtsa 'khor drug gi bar du bshad/ / de phyir 'og ma gdan khri'i dpangs/ /de nas zhal du bum pa'i dpangs| |de nas zhal gang bre dang gdong*/ /de nas zhal gang gdugs 'phreng ngo*/ /'di lhag sor mo lnga bcu'o/ /mchod rten dngos kyi dpangs su bshad/ /de yis phyed kyi gdan khri'i rgya/ /de dang bum pa'i ldir sa mnyam/ /de phyir zhal tshad dbus nas bskor| |de yis phyed kyi bre gdong dang*/ /gdan gyi sum cha bre mgul rgya/ / gdan dang bre dang gdong kun la/ /rang rang sum cha glog 'bur bya/ /gdan ni sa bzhin gru bzhi nyid/ /bya bar gsungs pa ma gtaugs pa/ /bang rim bshad pa med pas na/ /myang 'das lta bur mngon na yang*/ /pad chen dang bcas seng khri ni| |'og tu byas nas 'dir bshad gdan*/ /gzhi gtun bang rim bzhi brtsegs ste/ /kun kyang glo 'bur dang bcas bya/ /bang rim sor mo gnyis gnyis zhum/ /bum pa'i smad nas sor mo bzhi/ /pad+ma'i gdan bya bum pa yi// sked par pad+ma'i phreng ba ni/ kha sbyar dpangs dang bum stod nas/ /pad+mas bkab pa'ang sor bzhi'o/ /bre mgul sor gcig de lhag gdong*/ /gdugs 'phreng char khebs tog dang bcas/ /zhal gang po la ci mdzes te/ /mgul phra char khebs che na mdzes/ /glo bur kun dang pad+ma rnams/ /'bur tshad sor mo phyed dang gsum| |sa la bzhengs na bum pa dang*/ /bre gdong skyung zhing gzhan rnams bkyed| |mdzes shing dge legs 'phel bar 'gyur/ /gnyis pa thig gi bshad pa rgyas pa ni gzhan du shes dgos shing*/ 'dir mang bar 'gyur bas bzhag la/ 'dir ni blos longs bzhengs tshul la brten pa'i log rtog :snangs che [ mang che ] ba rnams bzhag nas rang lugs gsal bar brjod par bya'o/ / 'di la gzhi sna tshogs rdo rje la dang*/ rta babs dang*/ dngos kyi dpangs la dang*/ yan lag gzhan la mi mthad pa dgag pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis| rwa g.yas g.yon gyi rwa phyir bkyed nas bris pa dag bkag ste/ rwa so so'i dkyil thad la dbus rwa'i tshad kyis skud pas bcal bas gang sleb las lhag pa gtan mi btang bar 'dod la/

snga ma'i rje 'brang dag de la rmog ltar mi mdzes pa'i rnam pa 'byung ba sogs rgyu mtshan du byas nas snga ma kho na las gzhan mi rung bar 'dod do/ kho bo ni gnyis ka la'ang gcig tu nges pa'i sgrub byed ma mthong ste/ phyi rabs pa'i lugs des mtha' rwa'i tshad mi 'grub ste/ dbus rwa bzhi la bshad du rung bas so/ /dbus rwa dang mtha' rwa tshad mnyam phyag mtshan rdo rje'i phyag tshad kyi skabs su bshad pas mi mnyam pa mi 'byung ngo zhe na| der gsum cha mnyam du bshad pas/ rwa la cha chen bzhi las lhag pa mi srid pa dang*/ lte ba la cha chen bcu gnyis pa byed pa mi mthad par 'gyur ro/ sum cha mnyam ni phyag mtshan rdo rje'i dgos chos yin gyi/ 'dir dkyil 'khor gyi gdan yin pas skyon med do zhe na/ 'dir yang mtshungs so/ /des na gnyis ka ltar yang rung bar sems so/ / gnyis pa ni/ rdo rje bsnol nas cog rtse'i steng du bzhag pa dper byas nas phyogs bzhi'i rwa 'bur bzhi sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte ba la reg cing bzhi steng du drang thad sbyur mo byas te/ rta babs kyi mdun bkag pa ltar byed pa mi mthad de/ de lta na lte ba'i 'thug rngam cha chen bzhi pa las 'da' ba mi rung la/ de la ni rwa'i bseng rnams shin tu ches pas sgo'i mdun du 'gro 'ong sogs shin tu mi bde ba'i phyir ro/ /ye shes kyi snang ba la gang yang rung zhing*/ lha rnams nam mkha' nas thogs med du 'jug pas skyon med do zhe na/ 'o na sgo dang them skas dang dkar khung la sogs pa mtha' dag mi dgos par 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten dang sgo bstun nas dgos na ni 'dir yang mtshungs so/ /des na rwa dang lte ba phyag mtshan rdo rje bzhin du mi byed pa'i dmigs bsal bzhin du/ 'dir yang lte ba cha chen gcig gis 'thug rngams las lhag pa byed don med cing*/ de'i cha phran gnyis steng du lhag tu bcug nas cha phran gnyis pa la rtse mo lnga pa byed na'ang gcig phag na cig cung zad mngon pa tsam gyi chog go

/ gnyis pa la/ slong ba la dang*/ slong tshul la dang*/ srab 'thug la mi 'thad pa dgag pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sngon dang phyis kyi bla ma kha cig sangs rgyas gsang bas byas par grags pa'i gzhung las/ sgo'i phyi zur gyi grwa bzhir ka ba bzhi slong bar gsungs pa'i lung*/ sgo'i phyi zur bzhi po la/ ka ba bzhi bzhis gdung sna ni/ /brgyad brgyad bteg pa rta babs rmang*/ /ka gdan ka zhu ci rigs pa'o/ /zhes dang*/ dbus sbyur bu dang bcas pa'i cog lnga pa ltar mdzes par 'gyur bas so zhes pa'i rig pa ltar snang la brten nas sgo 'khyams kyi steng du slong bar mdzad pa ni mi mthad de/ sangs rgyas gsang bas byas par grags pa'i gzhung de mkhas pa dag gis bod mar bzhed pas brdzun lung yin pa'i phyir dang*| cog gi mdzes cha las/ sgo mdun rgyan med du lus pa mi mdzes pa che ba'i phyir dang*/ ko ba la lar sgo la 'jug pa'i gnas su byas nas de'i phyi rol du rta babs bya bar gsal bar bshad pa lta bu/ rgya bod kyi mkhas pas sgo bzhi so so'i mdun du ka ba bzhi bzhis btegs pa'i rta babs gsal bar bshad pa'i phyir dang*/ glang rgyab dang bcas pa'i gan+dho lar grags pa yang rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi sgo brgyan la yod par grags pa'i phyir dang*/ steng du slong pa la bri bya'i ka ba cha phran lnga pa las lhag pa mi byed na gzhal yas khang gi thog dpangs dmas par 'gyur zhing*/ thog dpangs gtod na ka ba bri bya las lhag pa'i blo bzo dgos par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ kha cig cha phran lnga pa'i thog dpangs nyid 'dod pa ni thog dngos kyi 'thug rngams la'ang cha phran cig dgos pas na thog dpang bzhi par 'gyur la/ de lta na lha rnams cha phran bzhi las chung thabs med pas thog la brdugs par 'gyur ba'i skyon med do/ kha cig dus 'khor dbang le nas 'grel pa med pa'i rtsa ba rta babs rnams ni sum gyis bsgyur ba'i bcu'i ri mig dag tu rab tu 'gyur zhes pas rta babs dang dngos gzhi sgo'i sum 'gyur du nges shing*/

dus 'khor ba sgo tshad re la cha phran drug pa byed pas bco brgyad dang*/ lhag ma ka ba'i dpangs yin pas/ ka ba dus 'khor ltar na cha phran bcu gnyis pa dang gsang sngags gzhan la brgyad par bya rgyu yin pas/ thog gi phyi'i dpangs cha phran bdun pa bya zhing*/ rta babs kyi 'og dang*/ thog gi steng cha phran cig gis ma reg pa gcig grub pa yin no/ /zhes zer zhing lag len la yang byas yod par snang na yang*/ rgyud tshig de la 'grel pa yang med cing*/ 'os med kyi 'bru gnon na'ang bri bya'i skabs yin pas rtsa thig nas bum rtse'i bar gyi bri bya'i tshad la cha phran sum cu yod par bzhed pa yin gyi/ 'dis ka ba'i dpangs la cung zad kyang mi phan no/ /gal te phan na 'dod snam dang rtsig pa bcad nas ka ba bzo dgos par 'gyur ro/ / gnyis pa ni/ rta babs sgo mdun du slong ba bzhir byas la'ang phreng bar thig skud ring thung gnyis gsungs pas thung ba la rta babs sgo tshad cig ma dpangs la byed pa de bri bya la bshad pa bzhin du bsgom don blang bya la'ang byed gsung pa mi 'thad de/ gzhal yas khang dngos kyi mda' yab dang rta babs kyi mda' yab ngos mnyam byed na rgya phyaid dpangs mi 'byung la mi mnyam pa byed na sgo mdun du slong 'phro la lus pa lta bu 'byung bas sgo'i rgyan du mi 'gyur zhing*/ ka ba ring du gtong na'ang blo bzor 'gyur ro/ /des na bsgom don gyi rta babs la sgo tshad sum mas khyab pa cig ma gsungs pa bri bya kho na'i dbang du bya'o/ kha cig lhung bzed che tshad chung tshad sogs kyi rig pas 'bring po sgo tshad gnyis ma'ang 'dod pa ni/ gzhan de gnyis rgyud du thig skud gnyis su gsungs pa yin na khyed kyi thig skud de gang nas gsungs tshol byon cig/gsum pa ni/ mkhas mchog kha cigaser dang bshar bu sogs dpangs la cha phran re re las med pa ltar 'thug rngams kyang de dang 'dra bas/ thig shing rtsigs su bzhed par grags pa dang*/

da lta kha cig dus 'khor thugs dkyil gyi rta babs zhes dang 'thug rngams mnyam la khad kyi gru bzhi byas 'dug pa gnyis ka yang mi mthad de/ snga ma ni/ stod mi mnyam pa dang ka ba bzhis 'degs mi shes la/ phyi ma ni gsung dkyil dpangs chung gi nang du shong thabs med pa'i phyir ro/ /des na ka ba cha phran re re ba gnyis gnyis kyi phyogs re nas 'degs dgos shing*/ ka ba gnyis kyi bar du cha phran gnyis mi bzhog pa'i thabs med la/ mtha' gnyis su'ang gser snam sogs gdung rnams cha phran phyed ma lhag na mi mdzes pas cha phran bzhi par grub bo/ /de yang spyi 'gro'i dbang du byas kyi/ dus 'khor ltar na drug ste mdor na sgo tshad gcig go / gsum pa ni/ sngar bshad pa ltar kha cig cha phran lnga pa dang bdun pa 'dod pa ni ha cang khang leb ltar shin tu mi mdzes pa mngon sum gyis grub la/ phyis kyi rdo rje slob dpon chen po kha cig dpangs la lnga sum dang rgya la lnga gnyis/ kha cig de las bzlog par bzhed pa dag la ni/ mdo nas bshad pa'i mchod rtain gyi dpangs tshad la sogs pa'i lung gi g.yar po re tsam ma gtogs rgyu mtshan yang dag mi snang la/ rje btsun sa skya pa rnams dang*/ lo chen rin bzang rjes 'brang dang bcas pa dang*/ bu ston chos kyi rgyal po dang*/ rje btsun tsong kha pa la sogs pa rnams rgya phyed dpangs su bzhed pa ni shin tu legs mod kyi/ de dag gis kyang sgrub byed kyi rgyu mtshan yang dag ni ma rnyed pa snang zhing*/ bu ston rin po ches/ ka ba rtsig 'gram du btsugs nas dbus su rtse mo sleb par rtse mo'i dkyil chog gis bsgrub mod kyi/ khyab pa 'grub pa byas kyang rtags de shin tu sgrub dka' bar snang ngo*/ /de thams cad kyang rta babs sgo mdun du slong ba sha stag yin la/ kho bo'ang de dag gi rjes su 'brang bas/ de rting rta babs kyi dpangs bri bya la ji ltar yod pa ltar bslangs pas rgya phyed dpangs su 'bad med du grub ste/

rta babs ka ba dang bcas pa'i dpangs la spyi 'gro'i cha phran bcu bdun yod la/ gzhal yas khang gi rtsig thig shar mtha' nas nub mtha'i bar la so bzhi yod pas phyi'i rgya phyed dpangs su grub cing*/ rtsa thig nas rtsa thig gi bar la so gnyis yod pa'i phyed dang bcu drug nang gi dpangs la byas pas thog gi 'thub rngams cha phran gcig pa grub bo/ /'o na mda' yab lhag go zhe na/ bya 'dab cung zad chu babs su byas pa'i sna mo la bshar bu dang*/ de'i steng du mda' yab byed pas mi lhag pa yin no/ /de ltar 'khyams dang rgya phyed dpangs su byas pa la bri bya la mi gsal ba'i ka ba brgyad kyis g.yab bskor gyi tshul gyis phub cing*/ de'i nang du gsang 'dus gnyis lta bu gzhal yas khang gi phyed tshad du rdor 'phreng yod pa rnams ni de la brten cing*/ kyai rdor gshed dmar lta bu pad+ma 'dab brgyad la sogs pa ma gtogs ka ba bri bya la med pa rnams la'ang phyed tshad kyi pad+ma'i shun par sogs su ka ba brgyad dang*/ des bteg pa'i gdung zlum dang*/ de la brten pa'i rdo rje'i gdung bzhi mig mangs ris su bris nas thog bar pa dbub cing*/ de yang 'khyams dang cha chen cig gi dpangs khyad yod pa chu babs dang bcas pa bya/ de'i mthong kha gru bzhir bzhag pa'i dra bzhir ka chung btsugs nas rgya phibs steng ma phub ste/ bar der steng gi khro bo'i bzhugs pa dgos na yang byas pas rgya phibs gsum thog khang brtsegs kyi rnam pa shin tu mdzes pa mngon sum gyi 'grub ste rgyud rgya gzhung rnams su bri bya'i dbang du byas pa 'ba' zhig gsungs pas thog 'bubs mi gsal yang rig pa'i rgyal po mtha' gzhan ma bkag pa zhes bya ba 'os mod kyi rigs pas 'bad med du grub kyi| tshags che yang don chung ba'i thog 'bubs kyi bshad pa kho bos mi shes so// 'on kyang bde mchog la ni 'khyams kyi ka ba mi dgos kyi/ sku 'khor gyi ka ba la gdung bskor btang ba'i steng du 'khyams kyi lcam rnams ngos kyi thung ba dang zur gyi ring ba byas nas btang stegs g.yas bskor bya zhing*/

de'i steng du ka thung btsugs pa la yang gdung bskor dang*/ gsung 'khor ka ba'i steng gi gdung skor gyi bar la lcam thad kar btang zhing snga ma bzhin du rigs bsgres nas dbub par bya'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ bri bya la mun snam yod de gang yin kyang rta babs rnams cha phran cig gi gzhal yas khang la ma reg par bya ba dang*/ glang rgyab kyi snam bu lnga pa'i steng gi ni/ zhes sogs snam bu 'chad na sbab le ltar bya ba 'grub la/ thig ma bshad na'ang rung bas snam bu phyed bshags sogs mi 'thad do/ /phyis kyi mkhas rlom dag kha cig 'dod snam kha khyer du bshad pas zer nas pu shu'i steng du 'gel ba dang*/ kha cig mtha' rin po che'i pha gus brtsigs pa zhes sogs la brten nas/ pha gus thang la phab te 'dod snam gyi phyi ru 'jog pa sogs mang du snang mod kyi/ 'dod pa rang dga' ba'i 'jug tshul mtha' med pas| log pa'i lam la mtha' med phyir/ /de dag 'dir ni spro bya min/ /zhes rnam nges las gsungs pa'i phyir na dgag gis mi lang bas/ mkhas pa dag gi bzhed pa la dgag bsgrub cung zad byas so/ / gnyis pa tshad ldan dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan dang*/ des na rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po la mi ldan pa'i nyes dmigs dang*/ ldan pa'i phan yon no// dang po ni/ bde mchog sdom 'byung gi rgyud las/ mgrin pa kos ko byin pa ste// gsum po ring na skyon chen po/ /sngags pa bdag nyid nges par ni/ /gnas las nyams shing bskrad par 'gyur/ /snyan dang shangs dang phyag sor te/ /gsum po thung na skyon chen po/ /dngos grub nges par 'joms pa dang*/ /de bzhin dpal yang nyams par 'gyur/ /byin pa zhal dang mkhur tshos te/ /gsum po sbom na skyon chen po/ /sngags pa bdag nyid nges par yang*/ /dpal las ring zhing bdud bgegs 'byung*/ /'gram pa gnyis dang rtsibs logs te/ /gsum po zhom na skyon chen ldan/ /don rnams nyams par 'gyur ba dang*/ /'dir ni bgegs 'byung the tshom med/

/nu ma shangs dang bral ba ste/ /gsum po yo na skyon chen po/ /bsgrub pa po de myur bar ni/ /dgra yis rtsod pas gdung bar 'gyur// brla dang kyus dang nam 'dzong ste/ /gsum po nyams na skyon chen po/ /chom rkun sogs kyi 'joms pa yi/ /'chi bar 'gyur bar the tshom med/ /mig g.yon sna dang rna ba dang*/ /mchu dang dpral ba dag nyams na/ /nges par sngags pa rnams la ni/ /sna tshogs bgegs dang 'chi ba 'ong*/ /gyen du gzigs shing dbugs bskyod tshul/ /gdan las g.yo zhing bskyod 'dra na/ /rang gi gnas nas nges 'pho zhing*/ /don rnams 'joms par nyid du 'gyur/ /mgrin pa nam 'dzong la sogs sku'i/ /skyon ni grangs med zhig tu gnas/ /'dir ni spyan sogs yo ba yi| |phyag rgya phyag mtshan nor gyur na/ /mya ngan sdug bsngal gyis rab gdung*// de phyir skyon brtag bcos par bya/ /rgyab yol dang ni gdugs dang gdan// gsum po chung zhing dog pa'i skyon/ /mdza' bos mi snyan brjod pa dang*/ /dpal nyams 'chi bar 'gyur ba yin/ /'di dag nyes pa chen po ste/ /legs par rnam dpyad brtag par bya/ / gnyis pa ni/ mtshan nyid thams cad yan lag rdzogs// gzugs mdzes cho ga mthong ba ste/ /dul ba bzo rnams thams cad la/ /legs par mnyam par bzhag pas bri/ /zhi ba la ni zhi ba'i gzugs/ /drag cing 'jigs rung drag po ste/ /dpa' zhing nga rgyal sku dpa' bo/ /bzhad pa'i zhal ni sgeg pa ste| |'dir ltar mtshan nyid mtshon byas nas/ /sngags pa rnams kyi thang sku bri/ / las dang po yis sngags pa yi/ /gzugs can la sogs bya ba ste/ /thang sku bsgrub bya rgya chen gyi/ /dngos grub myur du thob par 'gyur/ /zhes sdom 'byung le'u sum cu par gsungs shing*/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud du'ang bris sku'i phan yon rgyas par gsungs so/ / gnyis pa ni/ sdom 'byung 'grel pa la brten pa zhig gzhan du bshad zin mod kyi/ 'dir yang dus 'khor/ sdom 'byung rtsa 'grel dang*/

kṛ ya sa muts+tsha dang*| bod snga ma dag gi shā ri'i bus zhus pa'i mdo la brten pa'i phyag tshad mang du bshad pa rnams bsgrigs te rgyas par bshad par bya'o/ /de yang zhal phyag spyan la sangs rgyas kyi sku so so dang*/ 'gro ba gzhan gyi lus po so so'i dbang gis lus kyi sor grangs dang*/ mchu zheng la sogs pa shes dgos te/ dus 'khor 'grel chen du rgyal ba'i longs sku la rang sor brgya nyer lnga mchu zheng mnyam pa dang*/ mi phal pa la zheng du rang sor go drugamachur gya bzhi las med pas mchu zheng mi gab pa dang*/ de gnyis kyi bar byang sems gzhan la yod par gsungs pa cung zad zhib tu sbyar na/ mi phal pa la las rlung stong brgyad brgya pa phrag gcig 'gags/ sa dang po thob na brgya dang brgyad de nas dgu po re re la sor gnyis gnyis 'phel te brgya nyi shu rtsa bzhi bcu gcig pa dang bcu gnyis pa la sor gcig 'phel bas brgya nyer lngar gsal bas mi mkhas pa dag rdo rje sems dpa' bzhengs pa'i tshad/ gdong pa dgu las 'gyur ba med// zhi ma khro la zhal tshad brgyad/ /shin tu khros la zhal tshad drug /ces pa 'di kha ton du byed cing zhal re la sor bcu gnyis mar bzhag nas/ zhal dgu la brgya dang brgyad yod pa 'dir ring mthar byas te/ dus 'khor nas sor mo brgya nyer lnga dang*/ sdom 'byung 'grel pa sogs su zhal bcu gnyis pa yang gsungs pa rnams rang dgar 'jug pa dgag pa'i drang don du 'dod pa dag gis ni tshul 'di lta bu khong du ma chud pas nongs so/ kha cigaphugs kyi zhal grangs la khyad med kyang zhi khro rnams kyi sor mo la sbom phra yod pas/ zhal gang la sor mo phyed dang bcu gsum ma dang*/ bcu gnyis ma dang*/ phyed dang bcu gcig ma dang*/ shin tu khros pa sor mo shin tu sbom pas zhal re re la rang sor dgu mar byed pa yin no zhes kyang zer mod kyi/ de ni mi mthad de/ shin tu khros pa de sor mo sbom pa tsam du zhal gyi 'khor yang shin tu che ba'i phyir dang*/

zhi ba la zhal dgu dang*/ zhi ma khro la brgyad/ shin tu khros pa la drug la sogs par rang gis khas blangs pa dang yang 'gal zhing*/ dus 'khor/ sdom 'byung du longs sku zhal tshad bcu pa zhal re la rang sor phyed dang bcu gsum ma dang*/ bde mchog sogs la sor bcu gnyis ma'i zhal bcu dang*/ phag mo dang*/ bdag med ma sogs dang*/ tshangs pa dbang po nyi dbang drag po chu lha rlung lha sogs la zhal dgu pa dang*/ gshin rje'i gshed la sogs pa'i khro bo dang thags bzang ris dang*/ lus ngan dang*| bden bral dang*/ gshin rje dang me lha dang drag gza' rnams zhal brgyad ma dang*/ ro langs ni zhal bcu gnyis pa dang*/ kṛ ya sa muts+tshar mi'u thung dang*/ tshogs bdag sogs zhal lnga par bshad la/ 'byung po 'dul byed zhal gsum pa| zhes nag po chen po lta bu rang zhal gsum par bshad pa yang yod par grags pa sogs dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /des na zhal grangs ni dbu che chung dang*| yan lag ring thung sogs kyis bzhag la/ sor grangs ni zhal so so'i bcu gnyis cha'am phye dang bcu gsum cha la bzhag nas rtsi bar bya ba yin no/ /de ltar na dang por sor mo brgya nyer lnga pa brjod par bya ste/ gtsug tor sor mo bzhi| de nas skra mtshams phyed dang lnga/ de nas mdzod spu sor bzhi ste de ltar zhal gang ngo*/ /shangs rtse/ kos ko mgrin 'phreng 'og ma'i bar yang de ji lta ba bzhin no/ /de nas snying ltai gsang ba'i bar zhal re re ste/ de ltar na gtsug tor nas gsang gnas kyi bar zhal lnga'o/ /brla dang rje ngar gyi rkang la zhal dor ro// dpyi pus mo gnyis la sor bzhi bzhi long bu man la phyed dang lnga ste/ de ltar gsang gnas nas rting pa'i zhal lnga ste/ bcu po thams cad sor mo phyed dang bcu gsum pa mnyam pas brgya nyer lnga/ zhabs mthil gyi dkyus la sor mo bcu bzhi ste| de ni sku'i srid la rtsi don med do/ kha cig de dang thog cog bsgrags pas zhal do ste zhal bcu gnyis la bshad zer mod kyi/

kho bos ni sdom 'byung 'grel par ro langs zhal bcu gnyis par bshad pa ma gtogs longs sku zhal bcu gnyis pa bshad pa ma mthong ngo*/ /de bzhin du zheng du tshangs thig nas phrag pa'i bar la zhal gang*/ bar lhug sor nyi shu/ lag ngar bcu drugaphyag mgo bcu gnyis| gru mo dang mkhrig ma sor re re/ 'grel chen dang sdom 'byung 'grel par gsung mod kyi/ sdom grangs drug cu re phyed dang gsum du gsungs shing*/ mchu zhing gab par gsungs pa'ang cung mi 'grig pas na/ gru mo mkhrig ma phyag mgo rnams| dus 'khor bsdus rgyud kyi rtsa bar ma thon pa 'grel pas kha bkang la rags rtsis shor ba snang bas dang po gnyis la sum cha re dbri zhing phyi ma la sor phyed bsnan par bya'o/ /'di ni sor mo brgya dang brgyad pa la ring shos byed pa'i bzo bo sogs kyis bstan na lhu lag shin tu ring bar snang mod kyi/ rgyal ba nyid kyi gsungs pa ni gtso bor bya yi/ mi phal gyi mig sngar mdzes pa gtso bor ma byed cig de ma zad cung zad khros pa'i bde mchog kyai rdor dang*/ dag pa'i byang sems kyi sku la ni/ zhal tshad bcu po 'di'i steng nas sor phyed phyed kyi cha phri ste sor mo brgya nyi shu pa byas na'ang de ltar snang mod kyi snga ma bzhin no/ /zhal tshad dgu pa rnams la ni/ gtsug tor sor drug nor bu sor gnyis byed kyang dgu la mi thi bar byas sngar gyi sor phyed dang lnga pa thams cad bzhi pa dang zhal thams cad sor bcu gnyis par byas nas gzhan 'dra ba la/ dpyi dang pus mo'i sor bzhi po dang gtsug tor gyi sor bzhi po bor ba yin no/ /zhal tshad brgyad pa ni/ gzhan 'jal lugs dgu po de ji bzhin la/ zhal gyi dkyil 'khor dbyibs gru bzhir mngon pa snga ma las che ba cig byas la zhal tshad gzhan thams cad zhal de'i rang rang sor phyed dang bcu gcig ma la zhal du ming gdags shing*/ sor mo bzhi pa rnams phyed dang bzhi par byas pas zhal de'i tshad brgyad 'ong ba yin cing*|

drug pa dang lnga pa dang gsum pa sogs kyang des bsgres nas shes par bya'o/ /dper na zhal lnga pa la bcu pa dang gzhi khyon mnyam pa la zhal nyis 'gyur gyis che bar byas zhal tshad gzhan thams cad de'i phyed phyed las ming du btags pa bzhin no/ /de bzhin du zhal gyi rnam pa yang*/ rgyud las/ khyim bya'i sgo nga til rnam pa/ /gru bzhi dang ni zlum por bcas/ /thun mong sku rnams thams cad kyi/ /zhal gyi dbyibs ni rnam pa bzhi/ /skyes bu che dang lha mo yi/ khyim bya'i sgo nga til gyi dbyibs/ /mdzes shing blta na sdug pa yi/ /zhal gyi rnam pa gnyis nyid bya/ /yi dwags sha za 'byung po dang*/ khro bo rnams kyi rnam 'gyur dbyibs// zlum po dag dang gru bzhi ste/ /zhal ni gnyis dag bya ba yin/ /zhes gsungs pas| zhi zhal la sangs rgyas byang sems la khyim bya'i sgo nga dang*/ lha mo rnams kyi til/ khro zhal la khro bo spyi'i zlum po/ ha cang khros pa'i gru bzhi rnams zhal gyi gzhi gru bzhir byas pa'i dra bzhi ka nas cha phran gnyis bcad pa dang*/ gnyis ka nas gnyis gnyis bcad pa dang*/ gnyis ka nas re re bcad pas 'byung bar bshad kyang dang po gnyis la logs nas kyang re re bcad dgos la/ zhal bzhi po de 'khor lo bde mchog gi g.yas dang*/ rgyab dang mdun dang g.yon zhal gyi dbyibs su bshad cing*/ rim pa ltar sangs rgyas byang sems rnams dang*/ phag mo gzugs can ma dum skyes ma rnams dang*/ khro mo rnams dang ma mo dang dpa' bo dpa' mo rnams kyi zhal yang de dag dang 'dra bar gsungs la/ spyan ni rtsa zhal zlum po zheng du nas bcu dang*/ dkyus la nas bcu bzhi/ rgyab zhal la zheng nas drug dang*/ dkyus nas bco brgyad de gnyis lta bu/ gzhan gnyis la zheng sor gcig dang*/ dkyus sor gnyis te pad+ma lta bur bya bar bshad/ nas ni sor gyi brgyad cha la bya bar gsungs so/ /spyan rnams ni phal cher khro zhal gyi spyan du snang la/ zhi ba'i spyan ni sangs rgyas rnams la bsam gtan gyi gzigs stangs zheng nas gnyis dang dkyus nas nyer gcig pa gzhu'i rnam pa/

byang sems rnams la nas bzhi dang nyi shu ste ut+pal lta bu/ lha mo rnams la bde mchog gi nub zhal lta bu'o/ /de ltar zhal phyag rnams ldan lha/ /shin tu zhi dang zhi ma khro/ khro dang shin tu khros pa zhi/ /dang po'i phyag tshad gtsor byas nas/ /gzhan rnams khyad par cung zad brjod/ /phal cher shugs las rtogs par 'gyur/ /dang po la'ang longs sprul gnyis/ /longs sku bzhugs dang bzhengs pa dang*/ /gnyis ka'i thun mong mchu zheng ni/ /sangs rgyas sor mo brgya nyer lnga/ /zhal re phyed phyed bcu gnyis pa/ /zhal bcur mchu zheng mtshungs phyir ro/ /dag pa'i byang sems longs sku dang*/ /sangs rgyas sprul sku bde dgyes sogs/ /sor phyed bcu po phri ba yis/ /brgya dang nyi shur mchu zheng mnyam/ /sar gnas byang sems longs sku dang*| |phag mo spyan sogs gshegs ma dang*/ /sangs rgyas sprul sku shākya thub sogs| |zhal dgu sor mo brgya dang brgyad/ /dgu brgyad gnyis ka zhi ma khro/ khro bo phal cher zhal tshad brgyad/ /sor mo dgu bcu drug par 'dod/ /shin tu khro la zhal lnga dang*/ /sor mo drug cu re gnyis sogs/ /zhal tshad gsum pa'ang bshad ces grags/ /rgyal ba'i sprul sku yin na yang*/ khro bo rnams la mtshan dpe yi| |phyag ring mdzes sogs mi dgos kyi/ /mi sdug bco brgyad la sogs pa// gang la gang 'dul nges med yin/ /rgyal ba'i zhal tshad bcu po ni/ /gtsug tor skra mtshams mdzod spu rnams/ /sor bzhi phye dang lnga dang bzhi/ /shangs rtse kos ko mgrin pa yang*/ /de bzhin snying lte gsang gnas rnams/ /zhal re phyed bcas bcu gnyis pa'o/ /brla dang rje ngar zhal do do/ /dpyi dang pus mo long bu man// bzhi bzhi'i phyed bcad bzhi pa ste/ /zhabs mthil bcu bzhi 'dir mi bgrang*// de bzhin mdo la'ang zhal bcu ste/ /dbus nas phrag par zhal gang dang*/ /bar lhu phyag ngar phyag mgo rnams/ /nyi shu bcu drug zhal gang ste/ /gru mo mkhrig ma sum gnyis re'o/

/gtsug tor dbus su tshud pa yi/ /thog cog srid la bcu gnyis dang*/ /dpa' bo sems dpa'i brgyad dam dgu/ /thor cog srid la mi rtsi'o/ /zhal la sogs pa'i zheng tshad ni/ /zhal stod dgu dang zhal smad bcu// zhal smad bdun ni ci rigs bya/ /snyan zheng gnyis te srid du bzhi/ /snyan zhal bzhi sogs rtsi mdzes yin/ /spyan dkyus gsum lhag zheng du ni/ /nas gnyis bzhi sogs mdzes par bya/ smin dkyus bzhi po gzhu lta bu/ /snyan gyi rtse dang thad mnyam ste/ /snyan bug spyan las cung zad dma'/ /smin sprag phyed dang gnyis dbus su/ /mdzod spu sor gcig zlum zhing mdzes/ /spyan dbus sor gcig bshad pa ni/ /bde mchog khro zhal dbang byas pas/ /smin ma'i sprag dang mnyam pa mdzes/ /spyan ni nag cha sor gcig ste/ /'bras bu sor gyi lnga cha'o/ /shangs rtse'i gong ni sor gnyis te/ /mchu dang kos ko'ang de dang mtshungs/ /mchu sgros ma mchu sor gcig dang*/ /ya mchu sor phyed cher mi rung*/ /shangs rtse dang ni ya mchu'i bar/ /sor gcig bshad pa'ang bde mchog sogs/ /cung zad zhal gdangs la dgongs pas/ /shin tu zhi la phyed gnyis lhag/kos ko'i dpangs la gnyis bshad pa'ang*/ /de dang 'dra ba cung zad bskyed/ /zhal dkyus sor mo bzhi pa ste/ /dra gnyis gyen du cung zad gtod/ /smin ma'i sbom par nas gnyis te/ snyan gyi skri kha sor phyed skor/ /rdo gzhong lta bur sor gcig dang*/ /bu ga sor gcig zlu zhing 'dril/ /mgul zheng sor mo brgyad pa ste/ /snyan 'og mgul gnyer sor mo do/ /de nas phrag gong zhal re ste/ /sku stod sbom par sum cu'o/ /dpung lhu'i sbom par sor drug ste/ /gru mo phyed lnga mkhrig mar ni// gsum zer phras pas phye dang bzhi/ /phyag mthil gru bzhi drug zer yang/ /srid bdun zheng la lnga par bshad/ /gung mo sor lnga mdzub mo ni/ /de yi sen mo'i rtsa bar sleb/ /ming med de las sor phyed ring*/

/de gsum skye sa mnyam pa ste// mthe chung de las sor phyed dma'/ /rtse mos ming med sor gnyis sleb/ /mthe bong skye pa sor gsum dma'/ /mdzub mo'i sum char cung mi sleb/ /mthe bong tshigs gnyis mngon pa ste/ /gzhan bzhi sum char mngon pa'o/ /sen mo tshigs kyi phyed nas btsal/ /mdzub rtser cung zad ma sleb pa'o/ /byang stod sor mo bco brgyad de/ /byang smad bcu gnyis sta zur smad/ /bco brgyad byin gyis 'phel ba'o/ /brla yi zheng tshad sor bcu ste/ /nywa la sor drug byin bzhug bzhi/ /zhabs mthil che bar sor drug dang*/ /chung bar phyed dang bzhi yin te/ /gab pa'i tshul gyi cung zad skyung/ /mthe bong sor gsum sbom su gnyis/ /gzhan kun mchu zheng rim gyi skyungs/ /bzhugs pa rdo rje'i skyil krung la/ /pus mo'i rtse nas rtse yi bar| |zhal tshad bzhi ru nges pas na/ /zla gdan steng nas mdzod spu dang*// mchu zheng mnyam po yin pa la/ /bod 'ga' skyil krung dpangs dmas par// mthong nas sked par sor bzhi bsnan/ /des na shangs rtse dang mnyam zer// pus mo steng la sor mo bzhi/ /rting pa sor gsum steng du te/ /rting pa gnyis par sor bzhi lhag /bzhengs pa g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum dang*/ /bzlog dang sa ga zlum po dang*/ /rol pa la sogs gang gsungs rnams/ /dang po bzhi po sor mo rnams/ /logs su bstan par khyad par med/ /dang po gnyis po mtho lnga'i 'gyangs| |bshad kyang zhal gnyis tshad ldan du/ /btang nas brkyang bskum tshul bzhin du/ /byas pa nyid kyis kun la 'grub/ /sa ga rting pa'i bar sor bzhi| |brla dang byin pa drang por bsrang*/ /zlum por de dang 'dra ba la/ /pus mo phyir la gdengs pa'o/ /rol pa g.yon gyi sor mo ni/ /mdun du drang bstan de'i long bur| |g.yas pa'i rting pa bkan nas ni/ /sor mo logs su bstan pa nyid/ /g.yas rolazhes bya g.yon rol bzlog /mnyam pa sa ga zhes bya la// bar med mnyam pa bcer ba'o/

/gzhan yang bzhugs stabs mang bshad pa|¿|dkyil chog sa chog skabs rnams dang*/ /rang rang mngon rtogs rnams su blta| |de rnams zhal tshad bcu pa'i tshad/ /dgu pa la ni zhal ras nyid// cung zad bkyed pa brgyad po rnams/ /rang sor phyed dang bcu gcig la/ zhal re'i ming de dor nas ni/ /mchu la bcu cha gnyis pa la/ /zheng la bcu cha kun tu bkyed| |de bzhin zhal tshad lnga pa la/ /mchu kun phyed la zhal ming ste/ /zheng kun 'dab kyis bkyed pas 'grub/ /'on kyang sbom par sbom zhing grims/ /phra sar nyag cing mkhrang la grims/ /zhib rgyas sdom 'byung 'grel pa sogs// gzhan du blta zhing mkhas la bslab/ /gtso bo rgya bod mkhas rnams kyi/ /phyag rjes nan tan gyis btsal nas/ /bltas shing dpyad la lag len gdab/ /slob dpon blun po'i ngag rgyun dang*/ /rang gis sdug goms ngan lang gis/ /dad ldan yo byad chud mi gzan/ /thub pa chu lon mar grags sogs/ /phyag tshad rnams dang mi mthun yang*/ /mkhas pas byas shing grags che ba/ /kun gyis mthun snang grub pa yis/ /kun la mdzes pa snang ba 'gal/ /shes na'ang mkhas pa'i phyag rjes bltos/ /phyag ni gnyis ka'am gang rung gcig /mnyam gzhag yod na 'gying med bya/ /phyag mang yod na 'gal ba med/ /phyag g.yas gdengs la g.yon 'gying dang*/ /g.yon gdegs bzlog bya zhabs stabs kyang*// gang yang phyogs su dbus 'gying yang/ /bzlog nas 'gyel ba'i skyon du 'gyur// zhal 'gying gang du byas phyogs kyi/ /bzlog par byang stod 'bur ba dang*/ /rang sar sta zur 'bur ba gces/ /sum khugs drang na mdzes par 'gyur/ drang srong cha byad skem pa dang*/ /gzhon nu'i cha byad gzhon sha rgyas/ /pho rnams stod rgyas smad zhum dang*/ /mo rnams de las bzlog par bya/ khro bo gar gyi nyams dgu ldan| |brgyan dang mdangs kyi sgeg pa rnams/ /'gyings dang rol pas dpa' ba ste| |spyan log khro gnyer mi sdug pa/ /mdzum zhing bzhad 'dra rgod pa'i

nyams| |hūm̐ phaṭa sgrog 'dra drag shul che/ /mtshon cha 'phyar gdengs 'jigs su rung*| |spyan dmar gzhon sha'i nyamasadang ldan/ /zhal gdengs rkan brdab dang 'dra rngams/ /mnyen lcug sha 'jam zhi ba'i nyams/ /dbu skra zhal gang gyen rdzes shing*| |ag tshom smin ma'ang gyen rdzes 'khyog /mdor na yid la legs shar la| |lag tu btab pas nyams kun 'byung*/ /yid 'phrog bstan pa'i phyi mor 'gyur| |da ni khri rgyab bshad par bya ba la/ /dus 'khor rtsa rgyud dum bu las// khri la khri gdan dang*/ khri gdong dang*/ khri rkang dang*/ khri rmang gnyis dang*/ ba gam dang*/ lan kan nam pu shu ste/ bdun po byang phyogs sde tshan bdun dang dag pa sbyar ba tsam dang*/ rgyab yol la rgyan sna drug phyin drug dang sbyar te/ bya khyung ni ga ru ḍa ste snying rje dang*/ chu srin pu ra ṇa ste grong khyer dang*/ mi chung bha ra ṇa ste tshogs| |glang chen gu ra ṇa ste bla ma dang*/ /ri dwags sha ra ṇa ste dbang phyug dang*| |klu phrug na ra ṇa ste sgrol mdzad rnams rim pa bzhin shes rab nas sbyin pa'i bar phar phyir drug lugs bzlog dang dag pa sbyar nas gsungs shing*/ khri la seng ge glang chen rta rma bya shang shang gis 'degs byed dang*/ nor bu dang nyi zla dang pad+ma'i gdan rnams ni rim pa bzhin stobs dang*/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang*/ dbang bcu dang*/ smon gnas shes pa dang*/ byang chub kyi phyogs dang*| don dam e dang*/ kun rdzob waṃ dang*/ sgrib pa gsum gyis ma gos pa rnams dag pa dang*/ tshad med bzhi dang bsdu dngos bzhi la sogs pa rnams mtshon par byed pa sogs brgyan dang*/ dar gyi glo stan la sogs pa gsungs so| |bod snga ma dag gi khri la brtsegs nyi shu rtsa gcig la sogs pa'i spros pa dang*| rgyab yol rgyas pa phub la zhol btags pa lta bu dang 'bring po pad 'dab lta bu dang*/ bsdus pa lcags rtse ma dang sgong gzugs ma la sogs pa'i lag len mang du snang na yang 'bring po tsam gyi tshad dang bzo lugs shes na/

gzhan rnams shugs las 'byung bas 'di skad ces bya ste/ gdan khri 'phang du zhal drug bya| |sa 'dzin zhal gang de steng du/ /rdo rje'i gdan phreng sor bzhi'i dpangs// nor bu sum brtsegs sor gnyis te/ lha rnams sor brgyad nor bu gsum// phyed dang gnyis re de steng du/ /pad 'dab sor mo bcu drug dpangs/ /nor bu gnyis brtsegs sor re dang*/ /sum cha re ste g.yas g.yon du/ /cung zad steng gtod ci mdzes bya/ /rgyab yol dpung par sor brgyad tsam/ /bsnan la stod rgyas dbyibs legs bya/ /skor thig sna yi ci ran dang*/ /'og tu tshangs thig g.yas g.yon du/ /zhal bzhi sor lnga'i tshad tsam gyis/ /sa nas gyen thur thig re gdab/ /de dag rgyab yol phyi rgya'i tshad/ /stod rgyas smad phyogs cung zad zhum| |pad 'dab zlum rgyas dbyibs 'dra bya/ /mtha' skor mi ri pa ṭa dang*/ /rdo rje phreng dang zlum bskor rnams/ /sor mo phyi dang bzhi dang ni/ /sor do dang ni sor brgyad tsam/ /de dag bar bar mu tig phreng/ /sor mo phyed phyed mdzes pas brgyan| |de nang bar bskor ldem pa gtso/ /bkod legs mdzes shing khyad 'phags bya/ /lugs 'di deng sang mdzes par grags/ /'on kyang phyi dus gdan khri rnams/ /bzhengs pa shin tu nyung bar snang*/ /shoms na shin tu gal che bas// gang 'grub nan tan bskyed par bya/ /gsum pa la/ rdor dril ni/ bla ma snga rabs pa rnams kyis phyi dril nang dril gyi tha snyad mdzad pa la/ phyi rabs pa dganang gi rdor dril ni nges don ye shes la byed dgos pa las/ rtags kyi rdor dril la phyi dril gyis khyab bo zhes snga rabs pa la tshig ngan dang bcas te smra'o/ /de ni mi 'thad de/ 'o na nang gi gsang sngags de nges don ye shes la byed dgos pas rjod byed kyi gsang sngags la phy-i'i gsang sngags dang nang gi gsang sngags med par 'gyur la/ de 'dod na/ gsang sngags phyi nang gi dkyil 'khor zhes sogs rgyud sde 'og ma la phyi dang bla med la nang du kun la grags shing grub pa dang*/

yo ga nas bshad cing grags pa'i de nyid bcu la phyi'i de nyid dang*/ bla med nas bshad pa'i de nyid bcu la nang gi de nyid du mkhas pa kun la grags shing*/ rang gis kyang bden zhen gyi khas blangs pa dang 'gal lo/ /des na rdor dril gyi tha snyad tsam mdo sde 'ga' zhig la'ang 'byung zhing bya spyod nas lag len la yang byed mod kyi/ phyag tshad sogs kyi mtshan nyid ni/ yo ga dang bla med nas ma gtogs mi 'byung la/ yo ga'i bshad rgyud rtse mo nas gsungs pa'i mtshan nyid can la phyi dril dang*/ dus 'khor/ sdom 'byung*/ sam+bu ṭi la sogs nas bshad pa la nang dril du tha snyad nges par byed dgos pa yin pas ma dag pas dag pa la sun ma 'byin ciga'adi gnyis kyi ngos 'dzin la yang*/ mi shes pa dag rtse dgu dang rtse lnga la phyi nang du byed la/ mi 'thad de/ gnyis ka nas gnyis ka gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /zhi drag kyang de dang 'dra'o/ /des na de gnyis kyi khyad chos kyi gtso bo ni/ rtse lnga dang rtse dgu gang yin kyang rwa rnams chu srin kyi kha nas ma thon cing pad+ma la gnas pa dang*/ mtha' rwa'i rtse rnams dbus ra dngos la ma zugs par dbus rwa'i mthar pad+ma dang 'khor lo la sogs pa'i mtshon byed kyis bskor ba la zug cing rwa rnams ba di rwa'i tsher ma ltar rno zhing zur dang ldan pa yin par zlum por gnas pa dang*/ dril bu'i tshangs mgo'i zhal gyi 'og tu bum pa'i dod du bug pa yod pa dang*/ rdza mar grags pa'i steng gi pad 'dab kyi shar du spyan ma'i sa bon nam phyag mtshan yod pa rnams ni phyi yin la/ de las bzlog cing sgrol ma'i sa bon nam phyag mtshan yod pa ni nang yin no/ / de ltar phyi nang gnyis las 'dir ni nang gi rdor dril gtso bor bshad par bya ba la mtshan nyid dang dag pa'o/ / dang po la/ dus 'khor las/ zad par rlung me chu sa 'dod lha lha min rnams kyi rdo rje'i tshad/ rim pa bzhin sor gcig pa dang*/ gnyis pa dang*/

bzhi pa dang*/ lnga pa dang brgyad pa dang dgu pa dang bcu gnyis pa rnams ni| rim pa bzhin spyi bo'i nor bu dang*/ mthe bo'i rdo rje dang*/ dpral ba dang*/ mgrin pa dang*/ phrag par 'phyang ba'i rgyan dang*/ snying khar gdags pa'i rgyan dang*| lag tu sor ba'i rdo rje rnams kyi tshad du gsungs shing thams cad kyang lte ba dang phyogs kyi rwa rnams sum cha mnyam du byas la/ khyad par tha ma la kha gyes pa khro bo'i dang zum pa zhi ba'i rdo rje dang*/ dril bu la tshangs mgo de gnyis dang*/ kha yang pad+ma rgyas pa dang ba lang gi kha'i rnam par gnas pa ni de gnyis su bshad do| |rdo rje'i bar gyi de gnyis su bshad do/ /rdo rje'i bar gyi sum cha yang cha sum du byas pa'i bar ma lte ba dang gzhan gnyis la pad 'dab/ rwa rnams kyi dbus rwa'i bzhi cha mtha' rwa zug mtshams las phyir lhag pa gru bzhi pa/ mtha' rwa'i 'og gi sum cha chu srin gyi kha nas mthon pa phyir la sgyed pa/ steng cha sum gnyis nang du bsgur pa ba di rwa'i tsher ma ltar gru bzhi rno ba/ dril bu yang de bzhin du sum cha mnyam du gnas pa/ de yang dus 'khor dgos kyi dbang du byas na/ rdo rje'i lte ba la lha'i zhal bzhi bya ba ni/ tshad med bzhi dang*/ dril bu'i tshangs mgo la yang zhal bzhi bya ba ni/ rnam thar bzhi rnam par dag pa yin la/ bla med spyi 'gro'i dbang du byas na/ kā li thabs dang*/ ā li shes rab tu grags la gsal byed la dbyangs med par mtshon pas/ rdo rje la zhal med cing*/ dbyangs brjod pa dang bcas pa mtshon pas dril bu la bcom ldan ma'i zhal gcig go zhes pa tsam gsungs la/ bsgom pa'i rdo rje ni rtse mo gsum pa dang lnga pa dang bdun pa dang sor gcig pa dang gsum pa dang lnga pa sogs kyang bshad do/ /sdom 'byung dang sam+bu ṭi la sogs par ni/ spyi 'gro'i dbang du byas pa gzhan 'dra ba la rwa dang pad+ma'i bar du zla gdan nam/ 'od kyi phreng ba zhes pa cig bshad la/

dbus rwa'i rtsa ba zlum po dang*/ sked pa nas ltar sbom pa gru bzhi pa ri mo gsum yod pa bshad la/ dril bu la/ sher phyin gyi zhal gyi 'og tu stong nyid kyi rang bzhin bum pa| de'i 'og tu bre'i ming can tshangs mgo 'jug pa'i bu gde'i 'og tu pad+ma'i ge sar ri mo gsum/ de nas 'dab ma mgo thur du bstan pa'i pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i shar lho nub byang du sgrol ma spyan ma mā ma ki gos dkar mo rnams kyi phyag mtshan nam/ sa bon/ taṃ/ laṃ/ maṃ/ paṃ/ me nas g.yas bskor gyi mtshams bzhir nor rgyun ma tsun da khro gnyer can phreng ba ma rnams kyis/ saṃ tsuṃ bh+riṃ maṃ rnams dang*/ bre sor bzhi/ de steng nor bu snga ma tsam/ /glang rgyab sor mo phyed dang bzhi/ /nor bu sor gang bzhi cha'i tshad/ /seng khri sor mo bcu pa ste// nor bu snga ma tsam steng du/ /bad chung sor do bzhi cha'i tshad/ /bad chen sor bzhi bzhi sum ste/ /tsan+ḍa sor do bzhi chas dman/ /steng khebs sor gcig bzhi cha'o// srid du sa 'dzin zhal bcu gsum/ /lha snam sor bdun zhal bcu gcig/seng khri zhal brgyad sor bzhi'i rgya/ /bad chen zhal tshad bcu yin zhing*/ /gzhan rnams skyong 'bur shugs las shes/ /'on kyang zhib tu sbyor 'dod na/ /tsan+ḍa bad las so bzhis thung*/ /de bas steng khebs sor do bcag/bad chung bad las sor drug tu/ /de bas nor bu sor dos dman/ /de bas seng khri sor dos bcag |de 'og nor bu sor gsum bsring*/ /de 'og glang rgyab sor bzhi bsrings| |de 'og nor bu de dang mnyam/ /de bas bre ni sor gang thung*/ /nor bu gnyis ni 'phang tsam bsrings/ /pad 'dab rtsa ba sor gang bsring*/ /'dab ma'i rtse mo sor lnga bsring*/ /nor bu gnyis dang lha rnam dag /sor mo do do phyir la bkyed/ /nor bu gsum po'ang snga ma bzhin/ /rdor phreng sor dos sa 'dzin ni| |sor mo sum chas bsring bar bya/ /rgyab yol sku tshad nyis 'gyur dang*//

zhal gang tshad kyi tshangs thig gdab/ /'og nas steng du zhal lnga dang*/ /sor gang tshad kyi rgya byas la/ /de nas steng du'ang de tsam bkyed/ /steng 'og rgya nas g.yas g.yon du/ /bya rog rjes btsal thig cig gdab/ /de la dpung khri'i steng 'byung mod| |'on kyang mtha' gnyis sor lnga ma/ /stod nas thig gdab ci mdzes bya// tshangs thig dpung thig 'dzom sa nas/ /steng gi phyogs nas zhal do bsnur// nor bu ma gtogs sku de yi/ /zla steng gtsug tor bar tshad kyis/ /srad bus dpung khri'i steng nas bskor/ /rtse mo cung bsnan 'dab ma'i 'og tu phreng ba ste 'di la rigs gzhan gyis byed na pad+ma dang 'khor lo sogs kyis phreng ba dang*/ de las 'phyang ba'i drwa ba drwa phyed dang*/ kha khyer gyi gong du yang rdo rje'i phreng ba zhes bya zhing*| nang du lcags kyi dbyig gu zur brgyad pa bya la/ drwa ba drwa phyed kyi khongs su| shar la sogs pa'i phyogs bzhir g.yas bskor gyi/ 'khor lo/ rin po che/ pad+ma/ ral gri/ me la sogs pa'i mtshams bzhir/ spyan/ rdo rje/ pad+ma/ ut+pal lo| |dril bu yang sor bcu gnyis pa cha sum mnyam du bya/ rdo rjes sems dpa'i dril bu kha cig sor dgu pa drwa ba drwa phyed med pa/ tshangs mgo rtse lnga pa dang*| dgu pa gnyis ka dpa' bo'i dril bur bshad la/ rdo rje rtse dgu pa ye shes kyi rdo rje dang*/ rtse lnga pa dam tshig gi rdo rje/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud las bshad do| |rnam dag ni dus 'khor du sor gcig pa nas bcu gnyis pa'i bar rnams/ lus kyi nor bu dang*/ gtsug tor dang*/ dpral ba dang*/ mgrin pa dang*/ snying ga dang*| lte ba dang*/ gsang gnas kyi tshad dang*/ rnam dag sbyar ba tsam las ma gsungs la/ sam+bu ṭir/ phyogs cig gi rwa lnga ni rnam snang dbus su byas pa'i rigs lnga/ rwa gzhan lnga ni/ dbus ye shes/ shar rdo rje/ byang 'jigs byed/ nub ro langs/ lho gtum mo ste/ gdan bzhir gsungs pa'i khro mo rnams sam/
