gshegs ma lnga/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad cha gnyis kyi rigs lnga/ phyogs ni/ spyan ras gzigs| byams pa/ nam snying*/ kun bzang*/ phyag rdor/ 'jam dpal/ sgrib sel| sa snying rnams shar nas g.yas skor ram/ bla ma gong ma rnams gsang 'dus 'phags lugs kyi sems dpa' brgyad ltar 'god/ yum lnga/ phyogs ni/ phyogs bzhir lcags kyu/ zhags pa/ lcags sgrogs/ dril bu/ mtshams bzhir/ tsun+da/ rin chen/ sgrol ma/ lu gu rgyud ma/ gzhan gyis mi thub pa rnams su bsgom zhing ye shes pa bcug nas mchod bstod zhu ba las byung bar bstar zhing*/ mos pa lha'i rnam dag dang*/ bde stong dbyed med kyi mos pa bden pa gnyis ka'i dang*| stong nyid 'od gsal rkyang par mos pa don dam gyi dang*/ lam lnga dang*/ 'bras bu thams cad kyi rang bzhin du mos pa kun rdzaub kyi rnam dag rnams bshad la/ dril bu la sa bon ni phyag mtshan dang sbyar ba'i lha dang rdza ma 'dod khams| steng gi pad 'dab sa bon dang bcas pa gzugs khams/ bum pa shes rab kyi zhal la sogs pa gzugs med de khams kyi rnam dag dang*/ khong stong phyag rgya'i pad+ma/ lce zur brgyad pa thabs kyi rdo rje ste/ des pad+ma'i nang gi rtsa brgyad bskyod pas bde chen 'byung ba ltar/ lce zur brgyad pas nang gi phyogs mtshams brgyad du bskyod nas bkrol ba ni/ dril bu gnas brgyad du bkrol ba'i don du man snyer bshad la kṛ ya sa muts+tshar/ lte ba de nas snying ga mgrin/ kha dang sna yi bu ga gnyis/ /rna ba dag dang mig dag dang*/ /de bzhin spyi bor dril bu bkrol// zhes kyang bshad do/ /der rdor dril thig sgroms kyi khog nas 'don lugs sogs rgyas par bshad pa ni spro zhing nus na der blta'o/ /tshangs mgo dang rdo rje rtse dgu pa ni/ phyogs gnyis ka rigs lnga yab yum bzhi'i bha ba bha dra dbus rnam snang*| phyogs cig gi rwa brgyad sems dpa' brgyad/ phyogs gcig gi rwa brgyad sems ma brgyad du 'chad mod kyi/

pad 'dab brgyad la dag pa mi sbyor na ma gtogs bzlos par 'gyur ro/ /rwa rnams chu srin gy-i kha nas thon pa ni/ snying rjes sems can mi gtong ba'o// kṛ yar ḍā ma ru dang rtse gsum dgra s+t+wa ral gri sogs kyi tshad rgyas par bshad pa'ang spro na der blta/ phyag mtshan gang dang gang gi mgo bo rnams 'dzin mkhan de'i mtho re dang*/ yu ba can gyi yu ba rnams phru gang las mi thung ba yu ba'i mthar rdo rjes mtshan pa/ ral gri srid du sor drug cu pa dang zheng du sor bzhi pa yu ba'i mtshan nyid rgyas pa sogs gsungs mod kyi/ phal cher bsgrub pa sla la/ kha ṭ+wāṃg ni rtse mor rdo rje rtse lnga pa rdzogs pa/ de'i 'og tu mi mgo skam po sum brtsegs dang de'i 'og tu sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ yu ba'i rtse mor rdo rje rtse gcig pas mtshan pa'i lugs cig dang*/ yang na rtse mor sna tshogs rdo rje/ de nas mi mgo skam po gcig de nas rlon pa gnyis/ de nas rdo rje rtse lnga rdzogs pa la ba dan gsum pa 'phyar ba/ de nas bum pa bzang po shing los kha brgyan pa yu ba dang bcas pa'i lugs cig ste gnyis ka'ang yu ba'i stod sbom zhing*/ smad phra ba dri chung dang bcas pa dgos pa der bshad la/ gzhung gzhan du lugs snga ma bzhin las mi mgo skam rid rlon pa gsum gyi 'og tu sna tshogs rdo rje/ de nas bum pa yu ba dang bcas pa'ang bshad do/ /bum pa la zhi rgyas kyi ni lto ba'i sboms su sor bcu drug zhabs nas kha'i bar gyi dpangs sor nyi shu las mgrin pa sor drug kha'i rgya sor brgyad kyi dbus su sum cha bug pa/ mthar mchu sor gnyis 'chang ba yin la/ bsad bskrad la sbom sor bcu gnyis dpangs su nyer bzhi las mgrin pa sor brgyad pa yon po/ kha sor drugamachu sor bzhi/ dbang dgug la bzo bo mkhas pas ji ltar byas pa/ rengs pa la rgya dpang mnyam pa bcu drug pa/ mgrin pa sor bzhi/ kha sor drugamachu sbom zhing sor gnyis pas steng thams cad la rtsa ba med par gsungs pas lhung bzed kyi gsham lta bu/

bod la grags pa'i mchu med pa yin mod kyi/ kha nas chu sbyin pa mi bdai bas byas par snang bas 'gal ba yang med do/ / bzhi pa la/ bri gzhi ni/ gro ga'am/ shing shun nam/ shog bu dkar po'am/ tshos ma rang rang gi mdangs gsal ba/ rgyud gong ma 'ga' zhig las/ skra dang mchan khung du sba bar gsungs pas sor bcu gnyis pa'am bcu drug pa'ang gsungs mod kyi/ brgyad stong pa'i mjug tu glegs bam shin tu chen po la yi ge gsal bar bri bar gsungs pa sogs kyang yod pas skabs dang bstun pa/ rgya dpe la bug pa gcig pa dang gnyis gsungs pa'i dang po cha lngar byas pa'i lnga gsum lnga gnyis kyi mtshams su dang*/ gnyis pa la cha gsum du bgos nas bu ga dod pa'i mtha' bskor gru bzhi'i zlum po rgya ha cang che chung min pa mdzes pa'o// bod na'ang spyan bskor du grags pa'ang gsung rab chen po la rung ngo*/ /yi ge ni/ rgya gar na tshangs pa'i yi ge la sogs pa yig rigs drug cu rtsa bzhi yod pa rnams las/ bod kyi mkhas pa thon mi sam+bho ṭas kha che'i yi ge dper byas nas/ bod kyi yi ge ma sum cu/ bu drug dang bcas pa mdzad pa las rim gyis brgyud de khyung po g.yu khri dang*/ sum pa gnod sbyin sogs kyi dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa/ gzab chen dang gzab chung*/ 'bru chen dang 'bru chung*/ 'bru chen la li lugs dang ldan lugs/ bshar ma dang dkyus yig sogs pa yod pa'i nang nas gsung rab chen mo dag ni gzab chen dang gzab chung rgya gar mkhas pa'i gzhung 'grel rnams ni 'bru chen sogs dang bod kyi gzhung lugs rnams 'bru chung sogs su bri bar bya la/ yi ge'i mtshan nyid phyag tshad brda dag sogs ni spro bar nus mod kyi| ha cang mang bar 'gyur bas ma spros so/ /snag tsha yang rab gser dngul la btso chen dang btso chung sogs sbyangs 'dul legs par sbyangs la/ tha ma'ang snag tsha dngos kyang rung ste mdangs gsal ba dang mdangs ran pa dang*/ gcim sha chod pa dang*/

lag cha smyu gu dang smyug gri bdar la sogs pa thams cad tshad gcig la khel ba sla chos su ma song ba sngon du legs par sbyangs shing bslabs te bri bar bya ba yin no/ /de bzhin du khang bzang dang rta babs dang*/ khang brtsegs dang*/ de dag tu dgos pa'i shing gi mtshan nyid dang*/ rdo'i mtshan nyid dang*| so phag gi mtshan nyid dang*/ sgo gzug pa dang*/ ka ba gzug pa dang rgya phibs ji ltar bya ba'i tshul la sogs pa yang kṛ ya sa muts+tshar rgyas par gsungs shing shes par bya la/ gtsug lag khang che chung gang byed kyang phal cher gyi brgyad cha'am bcu cha sgo'i zheng dang*/ de'i nyis 'gyur srid dang sgo'i bcu cha ri bzhi bya ba sogs kyang skabs dang sbyar la/ thog 'bubs kyi shing brtsegs la sogs pa'ang dgos mod kyi rgyas par byas na yi ge mang la rags rim ni bzo bo phal cher gyis shes shing gnas mal gyi gzhi la sogs pa nas bshad pa'i 'bubs tshul ni da lta sgrub pa yang dka' bas 'dir ma spros so/ /lnga pa ji ltar bshad pa'i cho ga la sbyor dngos 'jug gsum las/ dang po la/ sa chogasta gon no/ /dang po la brtag pa dang*/ slang ba dang sbyang ba dang*/ bzung ba dang*/ dgegs bzlog pa rnams phal cher dkyil chog rnams su ji ltar bshad pa bzhin bya/ khyad par kha cig 'dir yang brjod na/ dge 'dun gyi sde dang*/ rten gsum sogs bzhengs pa'i sa'am yo byad 'tshol 'du byas pa'i tshe phyi'i bltas/ sa bon 'debs dang ljon shing 'dzugs/ /rta dang phyugs lug ded pa dang*/ khur bzang khyer nas 'ongs pa phrad/ /phyogs der longs spyod 'phel bar 'gyur/ /lha gsol mkhar rtsig bag ma len/ khye'u mang po rtse ba dang*/ /bkra shis rab gnas bya ba dang*/ /bzhad gad dang phrad bde skyid 'byung*/ /dkon mchog gsum dang chos sgrogs dang*/ kha ton bsam gtan bsgom pa dang*/ /ngur smrig gyon pa sogs mthong na/ /bslab dang 'chad nyan 'phel bar 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor ldan pas de dus dang*/

/de yi gleng mo byed dus kyi/ /rlung gi bltas la khyad par brtag |gzhan yang bya dang khyi sogs kyis/ /skad dang kha yi lta phyogs sogs// dus sbyor chen mor bshad ltar brtag/bltas mtshan bzang na myur du brtsams| |ngu dang snod stong khyer ba sogs/ /ngan pa byung na phyir la nur/ /yang yang ngan na rim gro dang*/ /gzhan du spo ba la sogs bya/ /gza' skar sbyor byed sogs kyang rtsi/ /byed pa'am sa rdo brko ba'i sar/ /rdo legs byang ngam shar ram steng*| kha bltas mthong na dge bar bshad/ /rdo ngan phyogs gzhan bltas na ngan| |sa brkos pa yi kha dog sogs/ /zug rngu rnams kyi brtag tshul dang*// gang du'ang dang por brko ba'i tshe/ /lto 'phye brtag tshul la sogs pa/ kho bos dus 'khor 'jam rdor sogs/ /dkyil chog mang por bshad la ltos/ /lho 'phye brtag tshul mdor bsdu na/ /ston zla gsum la mgo bo shar/ /de bzhin g.yas bskor byed pas na/ /ji tsam 'os pa'i zlum thig la/ /phyogs rer gsum gsum tshang ba yi/ /dum bu bcu gnyis snyoms par bya/ /re re'ang gsum gsum bgos pa rnams/ /zhag bcu'i gnas yin rags rtsis so/ /de tsam gyis rtogs rgyas par ni/ /de'ang bcu bcur mtshan ma rnams/ /zlum thig gnyis la bgos byas la| |srid tshad mtha' nas mthar sleb cing*/ /zheng tshad bcu cha'i tshad ldan gyi// shing ngam shog gu la sogs pa/ /lte ba drang por gzer nas ni/ /ston zla ra ba'i tshes gcig la/ /stod mdun byang shar ri mo dang*/ /smad rgyab lho nub ri mo la// reg par byas la zhag re bzhin/ /stod kyi mdun la g.yas su skor/ /dus tshes gang yin de nyid du/ /gnas pa'i mdun nas ri mo lnga/ /phyed bcad nang nas rko sa der/ /srid la bcu cha byas pa yis/ /stod du gsum dang smad du drug/bor ba'i bcu cha de nyid yin/ /re mig mang po dgos pa chung*/ /bkod pa'i dmigs nas brkos na ni/ /chos don 'dod pa dngos grub 'byung*/

/yon tan thams cad 'phail bar gsungs/ /mgo bor rkos na nye dus 'chi/ /rgyab du rang nyams gnas nor bskrod/ /mjug mar rta glang phyugs rnams dang*/ 'bangs dang stobs ni nyams par 'gyur/ khams lnga brkos sar shing brog sbur/ /skra sen thal bas 'tshe ba 'byung*/ rdo las rlung gi 'jig pa dang*/ /rus pas nad 'byung mgal dum gyis/ /sna tshogs rims nad 'byung bar bshad/ /de bzhin du dkyil chog rnams nas bshad pa'i kha dog dri ro brtag pa sogs kyi sas brtag pa dang*/ chus brtag par yang bya la/ sa gzhi 'dom gru bzhi ba byung dang bdud rtsi la sogs pa byugs pas/ slob dpon rang nyid khrus byas chas gos gtsug tor sogs dang ldan pas/ yi dam gang yang rung ba'i bdag bskyed bzlas pa mchod gtor dang bcas pa bya zhing*/ phyogs skyong dang zhing skyong la'ang gtor ma byin nas| gsang 'dus 'jam rdor du bshad pa'i/ khams gsum gnas pa'i lha dang klu/ /zhes sogs nas/ de ltar bdag gis khyod la ni/ /mchod cing gsol gyis ma bslu bar/ /rmi lam la sogs mtshan ma dang*/ /legs nyes bltas rnams bstan du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum dang*/ oṃ mu tsi li swā hā/ oṃ mo ha ni swā hā/ oṃ mu kha li swā hā/ oṃ dan+ti li swā hā/ zhes pa rmi lam brtag pa'i sngags 'di lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas te kha la sngags nas/ 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug la 'dun pas mchod pa sngon du 'gro bas mgo lho phyogs dang kha shar du phyogs pa gos gtsang ma bgos ste nyal nas rmi lam brtag cing*/ ngan na bzlog pa bya ste bskyar zhing*/ bzang na mngon pa dang mi mngon pa la slang ba dang*/ gnang ba gsol ba dang*/ sbyin bsreg zhi drag dang rdzas sngags lta ba stong pas sbyang ba dang*/ sa bzung ba la sogs pa dkyil chog ji bzhin bya la/ dkyil chog bri bar 'tshal/ zhes pa'i gnas su/ lha khang ngam/ mchod rten nam/ rten gsum bzheng par 'tshal/ zhes sogs skabs dang sbyar ba'i 'don pa spo bar bya'o/

/sa sta gon la yang*/ sa dang*/ lha dang*/ bum pa sta gon gyi dkyil chog bzhin du bya ste| lha la 'don pa spo ba'i gsol ba btab nas rnam par bzhugs su gsol bar bya'o/ khyad par du bzo bo dang rgyu cha sta gon ni/ rang gtso bo'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas bzo bo dang rgyu cha rags rim sogs dang*/ lag cha rnams bsags pa'i mdun du mchod gtor bsham/ bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlab/ bzo bo sogs kyang las sngags dang bgegs mthar byed kyi phreng sngags dang bdud bsreg pa'i sngags la sogs pa dang*/ las bum gyi chus bgegs bsangs/ swa bha was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bzhengs par byed pa'i lha de'am/ rnam snang ngam/ bgegs mthar byed du cho ga gsum gyis bskyed/ dbang thob pa yin na de rang yang bsgom du gzhug cing*/ grub na dbang yang bskur/ rgyu dang lag cha rnams kyang bsang sbyangs byas nas stong pa'i ngang las rnam snang du bskyed/ ras bris kyi thig tshon ni/ dkyil chog bzhin du bskyed pa rnams la rigs gsum mam lnga'am drug gi sa bon la sogs pa rnams spyi bo la sogs par bkod| ye shes pa yang yang du bcug dbang lha spyan drangs te dbang bskur/ mchod cing bstod/ na mo bha ga wa te shākya mu na ye/ ta thā ga tā ya ar+ha te saṃ myaka saṃ bud+dha ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ mu ni mu ni ma hā mu na ye swa hā/ zhes dang*/ na mo bha ga wa te bai ro tsa na ya pra bha rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te saṃ myaka saṃ bung+ngha ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ suk+ṣ+ye suk+ṣ+me/ sa me sa ma ye/ shān+te/ dan+te/ sa ma ye a sa ma bhe da ra be na/ ku le na ra wa he/ ya she wa ta/ ma hā te dz+wa/ sarba bud+dha dhaṣ+ṭhā na/ tiṣ+ṭha te swā hā/ zhes dang*| rten 'brel snying po bdun la sogs pa bzlas te byin gyis brlabs la/ lha rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i rgyu cha rin po che'i phung po dang*/ lag cha rang rang gi gzugs su bsgyur/ me tog gtor zhing shis brjod rgyas par bya'o/

phreng ba sogs su yig mkhan 'od dpag med du bskyed pa dang*/ smyu gu dang snag tsha byin brlabs bshad pa ni dngos gzhi yig mgo 'dzugs pa'i dus su byed pa yin no// rnying pa gso ba'i cho ga la arga'i cho gar grags pa ni/ chen po chung du gtong ba sogs ni gtan mi rung la/ rgyu dang tshad bzang du gtong ba'am/ gnas 'o rgyal ba nas mi rgyal bar spo ba sogs byed pa ni/ rgyud dang mkhas pa'i gzhung las gnang zhing rigs pas kyang thob pas/ 'chos rgyu'i rten gyi drung du mchod gtor gang 'byor bshams/ bdag bskyed gang 'grub bzlas pa dang bcas pa'ang bya ste| lha la mchod bstod rgyas par byas nas lha sta gon nam/ rab gnas kyi snyan gsan gyi tshigs bcad la khyod kyi dkyil 'khor bri ba'am rab gnas bgyid par 'tshal gyi nas khyed kyi rten ni 'chos par 'tshal zhes pas 'don pa spos pa'i gsol ba lan gsum gdab/ phyogs skyong la'ang gtor ma byin nas/ legs nyes bltas rnams bstan du gsol gyi bar lan gsum dang rmi lam brtag pa sogs sngar bzhin byas la/ rung bar shes na/ skabs su bab pa'i tshe/ cho ga snga ma la sang bgyid par 'tshal gyi gnas su da ltar bgyid par 'tshal bcug pa'i gsol gdab lan gsum gyi bar du byas nas/ rgyud sde 'og ma nas me long la gzugs brnyan 'char du bcug ste/ ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa mtha' dag me long gi nang du bzhugs par mos pa brtan po byas dar dmar pos zhal bkab rgyab tu rgya byas/ mgo mjug mi log pa'i mtshan ma byas nas mchod gral du bzhugs pa la mchod pa rtag tu 'bul bar bshad cing*/ kṛ ya sa muts+tshar/ rdo rje'i phreng ba'am srad bu kha dog lnga pas bcings pa la bzhugs pa'am/ yang na bum pa rgyan dang mtshan mas brgyan pa'i nang du bzhugs pa la mchod pa 'bul bar bshad/ dus 'khor rtsa rgyud du rang gi lag pa'i rdo rje la bzhugs par yang gsungs mod kyi/ slob dpon rang nyid kyi snying ga'i sa bon la bzhugs pa ni/

bla med kyi thun mong min pa'i cho ga yin pas de rnams gang yang rung bar ji ltar mos pa byas la/ gtsug lag khang dang mchod rten ni/ rnam snang du bskyed pa sngar bzhin bya'o/ /de nas rgyu cha rnying pa rnams bshig ste/ gsar pa la gang 'dre bsre ba dang*/ mi 'dre ba'am/ bskyed mi thub pa sogs yin na/ ri'i bug gam chu chen po la sogs la dor ste/ rnying pa'i rjes mi mngon par byas la/ gsar pa bsgrub tshul bshad zin dang 'chad 'gyur ltar bya'o/ / dngos gzhi la sngar med gsar du bsgrub pa dang*/ grub zin gyi skyon bsal ba'o/ /dang po ni/ gtsug lag khang ngam mchod rten dang khang bzang sogs la/ 'og gzhir bum gter gzhug par gsungs pas 'byor na rin po che'am/ ma 'byor na rdza bum gsar pa mchu lung med pa bre gang yan chad shong ba lnga byi dor byas pa'i nang du 'bru/ sman/ dri/ rin po che/ snying po rnam lnga dang*/ zas sna/ dar zab la sogs pa dang*/ rigs brgyud ma chad pa'i btsan po'i pho brang*| phan phyug gi khang pa dang*/ bang mdzod/ gnas gzhi'i sgo khang*/ grong khyer gyi dbus/ bod kyi zhing*/ 'brog gi lhas bzang po'i sa sna rdo sna/ rdo'i sgrom bu bya ba'i phyir du g.yam leb bzang po la 'og tu gding rgyu'i pad+ma dang steng du 'gebs rgyu'i 'khor lo dang*/ logs su skod rgyu'i bkra shis rtags brgyad legs par bris pa rnams bsham/ dge 'dun gyi bsnyen bkur dang*/ bzo bo dang ltad mo ba la ston mo la sogs pa yang tshugs su phyug par byas/ rigs dang gzugs dang lang tsho dang*/ dpal 'byor dang ldan pa'i khye'u/ bu mo gzhon nu bzhi dang*/ de dag gi lag tu bzung bar bya ba'i snod bzang po bcud nyer lnga dpal bshos la sogs pa yang thog par bya ste/ gza' skar dang*/ sbyor byed bzang po'i snga dro'i cha dus sbyor bzang ba la| slob dpon rang nyid sngags dang bstun na/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi chas gos bzang po rdor dril dang ldan pa'i 'dul ba ltar na/

chos gos rnam gsum legs par bgos/ dbu reg zhabs rjen/ dge 'dun gang yod kyang de bzhin du byas/ bzo bo dang las byed pa dang khye'u sogs kyang rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan/ bza' btung bzang po zos zin pa'i mjug tu/ gang du byed pa'i gnas der phyin te/ me tog thogs te/ yai dharmā dang bkra shis brjod bzhin phyogs der ji tsam 'tsham par g.yas skor du bcags/ shes na nag rtsis kyi phyogs brtag pa dang*/ skar rtsis kyi sgra gcan gdong mjug sogs la 'gram 'chol ba po'i gdong ma thug par bya zhing*/ mi shes na/ phyogs thams cad rang bzhin med par mos shing*/ byang dang shar gang rung du kha blta bar bshad pa bzhin byas/ 'dir yang lto 'phye brtag pa nas dbang ldan gyi zur nas g.yas bskor du 'gram 'dru zhing las mi yang las thams cad par bskyed par sogs byas nas bya'o/ /'gram legs par rnyed pa na/ khye'u 'am bu mo bzhi sogs lag pa g.yon du snod bzang po bcud gyis bkang ba dang dpal bshos la sogs pa bzung zhing g.yas pas srad bu bzung ste/ zur bzhi mthen du bcug nas phyogs cung zad kyang ma 'chugs par bya ste/ zur bzhi so sor phur bu gdab la srad bu la brgyangs te thig skud las ma 'chugs par 'gram gzhug go /phyogs 'tshol ba na phal cher smin drug 'char ba la shar du byed na'ang*/ smin drug ni byang shar nas shar nas nub byang du nub par mngon sum gyis grub pas khang pa phal cher byang shar du 'chugs par mang bar snang ba ni de'i skyon yin pas smin drug nam mkha'i dbus su sleb dus kyi nar stabs ma 'chugs pa'am/ yang na ston dpyid nyin mtshan mnyam pa'i nyi ma 'char pa dang nub pa la shar nub drang thad du bya zhing*| sa cha dang lung pa'i stabs kyi byar med na gtsug lag khang lta bu'i nar stabs dgos pa dgos kyis lung pa'i 'phred gcod du song zhing*/ sa phyogs de nyid kyi mdun la mdun yong bar bya'o/

/de'i tshe phyogs bzhi'i ri bzang dpyad dang ldan pa bzhi nas rdo legs tshad dang ldan pa re/ skyes bu bzang ltas tshang ba re len du btang la zur bzhir gzhug par bya zhing*/ gser dngul la sogs pa'i rin po che gang 'byor yang der gzhug par bshad do/ /bum gter yang 'gram gyi phyogs bzhi dang dbus su yang sa drug par rdo'i sgrom bu legs par byas te bzhag phyogs skyong gzhi bdag la gtor ma byin/ gter chen po'i bum par bsgoms nas/ khyed dkar phyogs la mngon par dga' ba dang khyad par gnas gzhi'am gtsug lag khang ngam/ mchod rten 'di srung ba'i bsrung ma thams cad longs spyod zad mi shes pa'i gter la longs spyod par gyur cigaphyogs 'dir gnas pa'i skye bo thams cad la yang dgos don zad med du 'byung ba'i grogs mdzod cig ces sogs kyis phrin las gzhol zhing bkra shis brjod par bya/ yid kyis gzhi der gang 'dod pa'i gtsug lag khang la sogs pa de nyid sangs rgyas thasam cad kyi ye shes la grub pa bzang zhing gya nom legs par grub zin pa la sangs rgyas kyi byin gyis brlob cing rgyun du shis brjod mdzad pa dang*| lha dang chos skyong thams cad kyis bsgrub grogs dang bsrung skyob la g.yel ba med pa dang*/ lha mi thams cad kyis nyin mtshan kun tu mchod pa 'bul ba dang*/ de thams cad bsrung 'khor thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i nang du tshud pas bdud bgegs nag po la dga' ba gang gis kyang mi mthong bar mos shing*/ sa chog gi skabs su phur gdab byas pa'i phur bu bsrung ba'i khro bo dang chos skyong phyogs skyong la gtor ma sbyin pa sogs byas pas bgegs med cing grub che bar 'gyur ro/ /lha khang la sogs pa shin tu rgya chen po rgya khyon dang ldan pa byed na/ gling bzhi gling phran gser gyi ri bdun ri rab dang bcas pa'i bkod pa'am rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang la grong khyer lta na sdug tshal gyis bskor ba'am/

dkyil 'khor chen po'i bkod pa'am/ gnas mal gyi gzhi nas 'byung ba ltar dri gtsang khang dang 'khyams dang*/ sgo khang dang*/ glo bur la sogs pa'i bkod pa'am/ chung ngu la ji ltar 'tsham pa'i dpyad dang bkod pas mdzes la phyi nang gi sa dgra med la mkhas pa yid 'phrog cing mthong ba dag dang ba 'dren pa/ snod ma 'jig gi bar du 'jig mi srid pa tsam gyis brtan cing bsra ba thog gi shing la sogs pa yang 'byor pa dang bstun pa'i gang shoms dang*/ gang mdzes mthong gsal zhing sa rdul chung ba la sogs pa sgo du ma nas legs par 'bad de rang bzhin gyi lus dang longs spyod don yod par bya'o/ /mchod rten dang lha sku glegs bam la sogs pa yang sgrub tshul phyag tshad dang sbyar te gong du brjod pa bzhin te/ bzo bo rnams rgyan gos bzang po sogs/ gso sbyong la gnas pa'i lag tu byin gyis brlabs pa'i lag cha rnams gtad/ khyad par yig mkhan skad cig gis 'od dpag med du skyed/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa hūm̐ gis smyu gu dang*/ oṃ a bigh+nan+ta kṛta hūm̐ gis snag tsha'i snod la lan nyer gcig re sngags te rdo rje dang chos 'byung du mos pas lag pa g.yon du gtad la/ oṃ dhiḥshu ti smṛ ti bi dza ya sarba ā dzñā na pa ṭa la a pa ha ri ṇi hriḥswā hā/ zhes bzlas shing shes rab dang ye shes sbyar te 'od zer rnam par 'phros nas gang bris pa de rnams yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro zhes mos par bya'o/ / gnyis pa ni/ dgon gnas grong khyer la sogs la/ /sa dgras skyon bskyed bcos par bya/ /gshin rje'i kha dang srin mo'i gdong*/ /brag dmar spre'u khros 'dra dang*/ /mtshon cha'i zur gtad logs zur nor/ /brag ri mi gnyis bshibs 'dra dang*/ sngon po ser khrab gyon 'dra rnams/ /rme dang gri 'dzing dmar ngo yin/ /brag phug dmar po kha bltas na/ /glo bur nad 'byung nor la gzan// nag po 'phongs 'dras glen lkugs 'ong*/

/gcan gzan gdong sogs mi mdzes pas| |don med rkyen ngan sna tshogs 'byung*/ /kun la mchod rten mdzes 'dra ba'i/ /ri las srubs med rdo blangs te/ /gser dngul gyi ni rin po che/ /'bar dang gtsug gi nor bu'i sngags/ /bris nas der gnas thams cad thub/ /mi gnyis shags 'gyed 'dra ba dang*/ /seng ge bya khyi 'thab 'dra dang*/ /de dag rdo la snga ma bzhin/ /sa ba stod smad ral dang 'khyoms/ /grags ngan 'byung phyir rdza las ni/ /rin chen sgrom byas shing thog dang*/ /'gron bu dung dang rin po che// sman dang 'brus bkang rin po che'i/ /gter du byin brlabs sbas pas thub// sbrul nag thur rgyug nya sbal dang*/ /sdig pa'am chu srin kha gdangs 'dra/ /glo gcong smu chu mdze nad 'byung*/ /sa lcags rdo las bya khyung gzugs/ /mtho gang lhag byas bstan pas thub/ rnga mo'i gdong dang rus sbal mgo /bya gcan sder mos brad 'dra na/ /yan lag khyog dang gzhon par 'chi/ /chu ser nad 'byung mi mi chags/ /rdo'am rdza la seng ge'i gzugs/ /byas te der kha bstan pas thub| |ri sna sems can gzugs 'dra dang*/ khyi tshugs sgyid tshugs rig sna zug/ skyes pa gri dang byes su 'chi/ /mi nor gnyis ka med par 'gyur/ /rdo'i rdza la seng ge'i gzugs/ /bzhi byas phyogs bzhir kha bstan cing*/ /zur bzhi gdugs dkar rgyal mtshan gzugs/ /dur khrod chu 'gram sdig pa'i rwa/ /skrag nyams sa mdog skya la hrod/ /bsod nams longs spyod dbang thang chung*/ /zas nor dgra mang tshig mi btsan/ /sha ba yu thod lu chu dang*/ /rin chen 'bru snas bkang ba sba/ /rdza yi skong bu phul re la/ /dgu ru sman sna bag phye dang*/ /bsres pa'i ril bu ba dmar gyis/ /ril bur btsos la skong bu gang/ /rin chen gter du byin brlabs nas/ /dbus dang phyogs mtshams brgyad sbas thub/ /srin mo'i 'doms dang mo mtshan 'dra/ /tshul 'chal 'khrig pa la sred 'gyur/ /rdo yi dbang phyug brtan bcas la/

/tshogs bdag gzugs bris bstan pas thub/ /ri yon thal mdog mya ngan byed/ /rgan mo nyal 'dras mi phyugs nyams/ /rdza yi ga'ur dri med gzungs/ rten 'brel snying po gur gum gyis/ /bris bzhugs rgyal mtshan rtse mor btags/ /mtshon cha'i rtse dang haṃ khung gzugs/ /gcan gzan mche gtsigs byab chu 'dras/ /gri dme mtshon dang 'chi nad rings/ /mtsho nang nas blangs rdo leb la/ /gser dngul gyis rdo rje rgya gram bris/ /shar sogs phyogs bzhir mchod rten dang*/ /me 'bar ri dang rkang gcig shing*/ /mtsho rnams yod na rkyen 'byung zhing*/ /rgyal blon mi chen dgrar ldang bas/ /shar du shel gyi mchod rten dang*/ /lho ru bum pa chus bkang bzhag/nub tu mi bsad mtshon cha gzug |byang du rin chen bzhi yi sa/ /blang te mtsho der blug pas thub*/ /steng ngam 'og tu rgya gram mam/ /brag dang chu 'thab sa yi sna/ /sbrul lce 'dra na god che zhing*| |mi 'thor ngag rtsub bzang zla 'gras/ /phur pa'am mchod rten byang phyogs brtsigs/ /bkra shis ri las rdo blangs la/ /gser dngul bkra shis rtags brgyad bris/ /grong khyer zhig 'dra zangs mdog zhom/ /rgad bu bya ra byed 'dra dang*/ /rgan mo ngu ba tshig mi btsan/ /brjid chung nor rdzas mi 'du bas/ /rdza gsar gser dngul zangs lcags bsres/ /rin chen 'bar ba'i gzugs byas nas| |ston pa'i ring bsrel sman bcas bzhug /mkhar ram dbu rtse'i rtse btsugs thub/ /stag rgya kha gdangs zor gzhu 'dras/ /longs spyod sgrub dka' rtsod mang zhing*/ /tha mar myur du 'jig 'gyur bas/ /glang chen sha chen rta rus la| |stobs po che yi gzugs bris nas/ /phyogs bzhir gdab cing rtsa brgyad dang*| |sāts+tshas bskor bas sa dgra 'joms/ /gzugs dang mi dge la sogs kun| |rab gnas byas nas phyogs der bstan/ /sa dgra'i rdo blangs 'gram 'og tu/ /sbas pas ngan dpyad mtha' dag thub/ /sa sgo gnam sgo ri bye dang*/

gong nyag ri gdong thag ring gi /lo chu'i rgyang mda' shar gyi bragamachod rten 'dra la sāts+tsha dang*/ /gab tshe bkra shis kyis bkang ba'i/ /rigs gsum rigs lnga'i rtsa brgyad bya/ /ri rgya'i steng du sāts+tsha'am/ khang steng rdo bzang bzhag pas thub| |gangs zer mthong sar me spungs bri/ /pha wang yo rengs sa 'og gzhug/ yang na de steng mchod rten bya/ /nub byang stag skya rgyun srang bcas/ /yang na shing gi khram gnyer bstan/ /lho byang 'brug sngon zam pa bya/ /lho yi rus sbal byung ngam sgrib/ byang gi bya dmar brag gis mnan/ /shing skam gang na 'dug kyang bcad| khyung glang 'dra la seng ge bstan/ /seng ge 'dra la mchod rten bstan/ /chu rgyun sa yi srubs pa dbye/ /thang la khram gnyer mang du bya/ /sa grum phug dang sa dong gsub/ /gong gi lam chen brog po yang*/ /mgo zlum ri la rtse mo gdags// yid du mi 'ong gang mthong sgrib/ /phyi yi dgra ni de ltar bcos/ /nang gi bcos thabs bshad kyis nyon/ /ka ba mthong ba gru gsum la/ /ka mthong ngos la zur gsum bri/ /ka brgyad g.yung drung ris re bri/ /nyi ma phyed 'grib me shel bzhag/ gong 'og gdung gi mtho dman la/ /stag pa shing la pho gzugs dang*/ /glang mar mo bris gong 'og brlan/ /rgya gram gdung gi steng 'og la/ /'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pad+ma bri/ ro mthon gdung lam gro ga la/ /rus sbal lkog sngags bris la sbyar| |de rnams ma bcos skyon mthun par/ /chom rkun 'byung zhing 'thab mo mang*| |byes su mi dang nor la gzan/ /sgo la sngur gdong gtad pa la/ /stag dang nor bu 'khyil pa bri/ /ral po gru gsum dus la gsum/ /phyogs la zur por shing cha rnams/ /drang por phub la bcos par bya/ /ma bcos tshe thung nor mi chags| |'khor g.yog mi 'phel mi kha sdang*/ /phugs mthos dkar khung mthos pa la/ /me tog rin chen 'phyang ba gdags/ /'khyams kyi stod las smad mtho na| |rim bzhin rdo rje g.yung drung bri/

/stod las 'khyams smad shing bzang na// rim bzhin ā dang hūm̐ re bri/ /gdung las phyi rnams sbom pa la/ /rim bzhin zla rdzogs zla tshes bris/ /ma bcos dpon g.yog go bzlog cing*/ /pha la bu mi nyan pa dang*/ khyo las chung ma dbang cher 'gyur/ /phyi sgo gnyis byas go sar bstan// sgo gong byang chen mchod rten bzhengs/ /sgo gong gdung bkal rtags brgyad bri// gzhan gyi khang zur zug pa la/ /lha babs mchod rten logs la bzhengs/ /tshang bang gzhan las mthos na smad/ /'khor par rang thag btsugs 'khor na/ khro bo'i drag sngags bris pas thub/ /bre la gdong btsugs bum gter gzhug /ro mchan bton la gter gzhug gsub/ /ma bcos nang 'thab 'bru mi smin/ /nor phyugs gdo che gang stongs yong*/ khang bdag 'phos dang zhig mang la/ /'khor lo rtsibs lngar 'byung ba lnga'i/ /sngags 'bri rtsi sman dkus la dril/ /rus sbal khog dang rin chen bcas/ /bcug nas gdung la mkhas phyir bstan/ /g.yos ma gdung gi thad sor dang*/ /nyal ba'i thad du gdung byung na/ /gdung la khram gsum bris pas thub/ /shing gi mgo mjug log pa la/ /shing la bri bya ma bcos na| |'khor 'chi na tsha 'byung phyir bcos/ /bug pa mang na sris mi smi/ /sgo la bug pa nang 'tshags chung*/ /nang du brag cha 'byung ba dang*/ /shing gi kha hrag shar bsnan dang*/ /phyam sna gdung sna phyir mthon dang*/ /phyi sgo byang ngam nub bstan dang*| khang pa gru gsum gyen la nar/ /ka ba kha yar rtsig zug mang*/ /nyi zla lan gnyis 'char ba dang*/ /nyi zla khal du bkal ba dang*/ sgo kun thad kar zangs thal rnams/ /nad dang sdug bsngal yid mi bde/ /mgron mang 'thab rtsod 'byung phyir bcos/ /spyir na yon tan mang ldan yang*/ /skyon can cig gis 'joms pa dang*/ /skyon mang de las ldog pa'i phyir/ /chos kun mnyam nyid du shes shing*/ /tshogs gnyis rgya chen sngon song ba'i/ /bshes gnyen yon tan kun ldan dang*/ /rten gsum byin brlabs khyad 'phags dang*/

/ngan dpyad mtha' dag thub par 'gyur/ /de phyir de dag 'bad pas btsal/ /shes pa'i skyon rnams legs par bcos/ /mi shes bzlog phyir dge la 'bad/ /yul khams bkra shis 'byung 'dod pas/ /shar du ljon shing khyad 'phags gzug /lho ru bum gter bzang po gzhug /nub tu rigs gsum mgon po brtsig /byang du tshad ldan mchod rten bzhengs/ /bkra shis dge mtshan gzhan yang bya/ /zhes pa rnams bstan pa rin po che yun ring du gnas pa dang 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang phan bde 'byung ba'i rten 'brel khyad par ba yin pas legs par bslab la blang dor bya'o/ /mjug ni legs par grub nas thog mar bzo bo rnams yon rdzong la kha smras la sogs med par mnyes par bya zhing*/ rten gsum rab gnas dang mnga' gsol gyis bkra shis shing rgyun brtan par bya ba yin pas rab gnas kyi sngon du dgos pa'i gzungs bzhugs spyi dgos rnams ma 'chugs pa shin tu gal che ste/ dus phyis kyi mkhas rlom bstan pa la dbang za ba rnams kyis rtog bzo mang du byas shing rten bzhengs kyang phran tshegs dar du song zhing*/ de dag la rang bzo'i gzungs bzhugs byas pas phyin ci log tu song ba dag gis bod 'bangs 'thab rtsod kyis gang ba 'di'i dngos rgyu byas par nges pa'i phyir ro/ /des na gzungs bzhugs spyir bstan pa dang*/ gnod sbyin 'khor lo bye brag tu bshad pa dang*/ des gnam rgyan gyi dkyil 'khor bri tshul bde blag tu grub pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sku gzugs dang mchod rten gyi nang du bzhugs par bya ba'i ring bsrel ni bzhir gsungs te/ sku gdung gi dang*/ yungs 'bru lta bu'i dang*/ sku bal gyi dang*/ chos sku'i ring bsrel te/ gdung rus rkyang pa dang*/ ring bsrel dngos dang*/ dbu skra phyag sen dang*/ gzungs sngags te/ dang po gsum ni gos dar ram/ ras kyi thums bzang por dri sman khyad par can dang bcas te rten gyi ji ltar mtho sar bzhugs shing*/

gang zag dman pa'i rus pa sogs ni rten gyi nang du bcug na/ de la gang zag khyad par can gyi phyag mchod mdzad pa'i tshe/ gang zag de la shin tu gnod par 'od srung rdzogs byed kyi gtam rgyud las grub pas mi rung la/ gal te 'jug na lhar bskyed pa'am/ rus chog khyad par can byas te sāts+tsha gdab pa'am/ yi ge'i snag tshar bsre ba sogs byas na rung ngo des na dang po gsum ni/ sangs rgyas dngos sam/ de dang 'dra ba'i gang zag khyad par can gyi dbang du byas| bzhi pa la stod smad kun tu rung ba'i gzungs chen bzhi'am lngar grags te| gtsug tor rnam rgyal dang*/ dri med dang*/ byang chub rgyan 'bum dang*/ gsang ba ring bsrel rnams sam/ ye dharma dang lnga'o/ /oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swa hā/ zhes pa srog shing brten pa'i gzungs te mchod rten gyi srog shing mang du bkri/ lha sku che ba rnams la'ang tsan dan dkar po'am/ shug dkar sogs gang ran byas te bkri bar bya'o/ /oṃ sarba byid swa hā/ zhes pa rig pa chen po'i gzungs ni/ mchod rten kyi bum pa dang*/ lha'i thugs ka dang*/ thang ga'i yang rgyab kyi thugs ka'i thad du mang du bzhugs shing bri'o/ /gzhan yang mig sa snying*/ rna ba phyag rdor la sogs pa'i skye mched sku gsung thugs dang lus dkyil gyi lha la sogs pa'i snying po dang sa bon yang gnas der gzhug par bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu bla med kyi gtso bo dus kyi 'khor lo dang*/ kyai rdo rje gnyis su med pa'i rgyud sde dang de nas ma rgyud bde mchog 'khor lo dang bcas pa dang*/ de nas pha rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa la sogs te/ bla med rnams thugs ka dang*/ de nas rnal 'byor rgyud rnams lte ba dang*/ bya spyod rnams sku smad dang*/ chos skyong dang nor lha rnams pad gdan la gzhug ste/ gzungs 'bum chen mo'i rim pa bzhin nam/ mi tshud na btus te ji ltar 'os pa gzhug par bya la/ gzungs kun la yang sngon du rab gnas bsdus pa re grub na legs shing grub bam ma grub kyang rung ste/

rab gnas dngos kyi dus su yig 'bru'i rab gnas rgyas par bya'o/ /rgyud sde'i rigs dbye la sogs pa ni/ gzhan du mang po bris zin pas 'dir ma spros so// gzungs rnams kyang rab gser dngul/ 'bring zangs/ tha ma snag tshas bris pa'i par du byas pa'ang rung ste/ yi ge dag pa shin tu gal che zhing*/ dbu gzungs rnams gdung rus kyis bri'ang rung zhing*/ yi ge rab lañdza/ 'bring dbu can/ tha ma dbu med du bris pas kyang 'grub ste/ thams cad bsgril lugs shin tu dam pa mi 'jig pa dang dbu zhabs mi log pa'i mtshan ma byas/ dri zhim pos cung zad dkus te rten gyi nang yang dri bzang ba ko ba tsam byugs pas skam ste bgegs bskrad/ gu gul gyis bdug pa dang bcas pa byas nas blo shin tu zhib pas stod gzungs smad gzungs rnams ma 'chol ba dang mgo 'jug ma log pa tshags shin tu dam pas gzhugs par bya'o/ / gnyis pa/ gzhan 'dod pa dgag pa ni/ phyis kyi bstan 'dzin rang bzo shes pa la mkhas par byed cing*/ rang gi myong ba dang mngon sum ltar snang rgyu mtshan du byas nas shin tu lkog gyur gyi gzhal bya lung rnam dag 'ga' zhig gi 'jal dgos rnams la dbang za bar byed pa dag gis 'dod tshul du ma byas te/ kha cig gis pho 'khor steng du byas pa gzhir byas la gtso bo yab yum dbu shar bstan mdun nub bstan/ 'khor thams cad dbu nang bstan la/ 'og ma phyogs mtshams ji bzhin g.yas skor dang*/ steng ma g.yon skor du byas pas yab yum so so zhal sbyar ba 'ong zhing langs pa'i tshe na pho phyi nas zhal nang bstan dang mo nang nas de la zhal bstan pa 'ong bar shog phu pad 'dab so so bkol nas dras te sbyar nas grub pas 'di las lhag pa med do zhes zer zhing*/ deng sang lugs 'di shin tu dar bar yang 'gyur ro/ kha cig steng g.yon skor dgos pa bden mod kyi/ gtso bo dbu shar bstan du byas na zhal nang bstan shar du byed dgos pa dang 'gal zhing*/

shar gyi 'khor gtso bo'i rgyab tu 'byung ba'i skyon yod pas dbu nub bstan yin la/ 'khor gyi dbu nang du bstan pa dang phyin ci log yin pas phyir bstan du byed la/ de langs pa'i tshe gtso bo yab yum zhal nub tu bstan pa 'ong bar mthong zhing*/ dpa' bo gcig sgrub kyi rgyud du mo 'khor nyis brtsegs sgrub thabs bshad pa la brten pa dang*/ ras bris sgyel ba'i tshe pho 'og tu 'ong bar mngon sum gyis grub pa rgyu mtshan du byas nas/ mo rkyang nyis rtsegs ni dgos pa chung la pho gtso bor byed na pho 'og dang*/ mo gtso bor byed na mo 'og tu byas nas 'dri ba'i rnam gzhag rgyas par byed do/ /'di dag ni 'thad pa ma yin te/ lung rig dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /lung ni/ rten gyi gzungs bzhugs la 'khor lor byed pa mi gsal yang*/ dpa' bo gcig bsgrub tu spyir nor sgrub pa la gser dngul sogs kyi snod steng 'og la mo 'khor nyis sbyar ram/ pho mo sbyar bar bya bar gsungs pa'i steng 'og gnyis ka la phyogs dang phyogs bral g.yas skor kho na bya bar gsungs pa 'dis/ khyed ltar na rdo rje 'chang gi gdul bya bslus par 'gyur te/ 'di la steng 'og mi 'grig pa mngon sum gyis grub pas nyes dmigs shin tu chen po yod pa gang zhig rgyud dang mkhas pa'i rgya gzhung kun tu skyon yon phra mo la yang blang dor bya bar gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ / steng 'khor la g.yon skor bya bar dngos su ma gsungs kyang don la mi byed dka' med de/ gnyis ka la g.yas skor byas na shar lho'i lha dang*/ byang shar gyi lha| lho'i lha dang byang gi lha zhal sbyar 'ong bar mngon sum gyis grub pa'i phyir ro| |zhe na/ de ltar na rig pa dang 'gal te logs bris dang*/ 'grems thang gi steng gi lha gtso bor 'khor lor bsgyur ba lta bu/ nub kyi nub tu 'dri bar ma gsungs kyi shar gyi shar du 'dri bar gsungs kyang*/

don la bzlog par 'gyur te| ma slog na/ de dkyil 'khor pa thams cad kyi 'og tu 'byung zhing*/ 'og gi gnod mdzes steng du 'byung bar mngon sum gyis grub pa'i phyir/ lha shar phyogs pa thams cad dbu nang bstan du 'dri dgos par 'gyur te/ phyir bstan la mgo mjug log 'ong bar mngon sum gyis grub pa'i phyir/ khyad par gtso bo dbu shar bstan ni shin tu'ang tha chad de/ lugs phyi mas bkag pa ltar/ pūrba zhes pa shar dang nub gnyis ka'i skad dod yin zhing*/ pañtsi ma zhes pa nub dang rgyab kyi skad dod yin pas ming gi rnam grangs yin par rgyab tu kha bltas pa las skyon che ba ci zhig yod/ yig mgo nang du bstan pa ni rje btsun grags rgyal gyi sngon du'ang byung 'dug pas/ bla ma des las 'jam po gsum la yig mgo phyir bstan bya bar rgyud las gsungs pa dang 'gal zhes bkag pa bzhin dus 'khor sogs su gsal bar 'byung ngo lugs phyi mas nyes pa mi mthong nas/ zhal shar du bstan kyang steng 'khor g.yon du bskor bas skyon zhugs te/ g.yas sam shar rnam grangs yin pa las gtso bo'i g.yas kyi lha g.yon dang g.yon gyi lha g.yas su 'byung ba'i phyir/ pho gtso bor gyur pa la pho 'og tu 'byung bar ras bris sgyel ba'i mngon sum gyis grub na/ bzlog nas kyang khas blang dgos par 'gyur te/ kak+ṇi sogs kyi gnam rgyan la pho steng du 'byung ba la mngon sum gyis grub pa'i phyir ro/ /mngon sum la rtsis byed na pho 'og tu mi rigs te/ 'og tu byas na pho mo go log par mngon sum gyis grub cing*/ de 'dra don thob kyi rig pa dang 'jig rten kyi tha snyad thams cad dang 'gal ba'i phyir/ de dag ni mngon sum phal pa la snang ba tsam yin gyi/ don la bzhengs nas pho mo zhal sbyor mdzad pa yin pas skyon med do ce na/ de lta na lho'i lha dang byang gi lha zhal sbyar bar mngon sum la bris pa phal pa la snang ba yin gyi/

don la lho'i pho mo dang byang gi pho mo sogs zhal sbyor du 'ong bas shog ldebs lag tu bzung ba'i mngon sum la brten pa'i nga ro ma byed cig brgal rtags 'di dag la mdzems nas lder sku sogs kyi 'bur ma byed pa rnams kyang mi 'thad de/ rgyud du snod dam byang bu la bris pa kha sbyar gyi bar du nor 'bru dang zas la sogs pa bcug ste sbrang rtsis kha bsdams nas sgrub par nan gyis gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na/ gang phyir rgyal las chos mkhas 'ga' yang 'jig rten dag na yod min te/ /des na drang srong rang nyid kyis bzhag thub tshul gang yin de mi daskrugs/ /zhes rgyud blar byams mgon gyis gsung pa ni tshul lugs 'di 'dras mtshon nas rang bzos bstan pa 'dzin pa rnams la go rgyu re nas gsungs pa'o/ /gzhan yang*/ mngon sum phal pa la steng 'og ji bzhin ma 'grig pas thabs shes ma 'grig pa sogs kyi skyon 'byung na/ steng 'og gang rung gi yi ge rnams kyang go slog dgos par 'gyur zhing*| de ltar 'dod cing lag len la yang 'gal na/ yab yum thabs shes sbyor ba'i tshe g.yas zhal dang g.yas zhal/ phyag zhabs g.yas pa dang g.yas pa/ nu ma g.yas pa dang g.yas pa sogs mi 'grig pas yab yum gang rung cig gi g.yas g.yon thams cad go bzlog dgos par 'gyur zhing*/ thang sku'i rgyab yig sogs la'ang yig log 'dri dgos par 'gyur te nyes pa mtshon pas chog go des na rang nyid kyi lugs ni/ dpa' bo gcig sgrub kyi rgyud le'u gnyis pa las/ oṃ ba su dhā ri ṇ+yai swā hā/ oṃ tsan+d+ra kān+d+yai swā hā/ oṃ rtā yai swā hā/ oṃ su rtā yai swā hā/ oṃ ār+ya yai swā hā/ oṃ su bha trā yai swā hā/ oṃ gup+tā yai swā hā/ hūm̐ de w+yai swā hā/ oṃ swa ra swa t+yai swā hā/ gser gyi snod dam zangs ma'i snod kyang rung ste/ 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus su nor 'dzin ma dang*/ shar la sogs pa'i phyogs bzhi dang*/

yang phyogs bral gyi 'dab ma rnams la tsan+d+ra kin+ti la sogs pa'i gnod sbyin chen mo rnams mngon par bris pa'i snod gnyis kha sbyar te mar dang sbrang rtsi dang ka ra rnams bcug nas sngar gsungs pa'i cho gas thams cad byed do/ /oṃ dzam+bhā la dza len+d+rā ye swā hā/ oṃ ma ṇi bha drā ye swā hā/ oṃ sur+ṇa bha dra ye swā hā/ oṃ dha na dā ya swā hā= oṃ bai shra ba ṇa ya swā hā/ phyogs su'o/ /phyogs bral du/ oṃ ki li mi li ne swā hā/ oṃ pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa la ya swā hā/ oṃ mu ṣan+d+rā ya swā hā/ oṃ tsa ran+d+ra ya swā hā/ gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po chen po brgyad kyi yongs su bskor ba/ ba su dhā ra dang bcas pa'i bcom ldan 'das gser gyi mdog can na gu le dang bī dza pū ra 'dzin pa gsus pa 'phyang ba rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa sngar gsungs pa'i gnod sbyin mo dang bcas pa'i gnos sbyin gyi dbang pos 'jig rten gsum gyi rgyal srid ster bar 'gyur ro/ / thun gsum du mngon par mchod de/ bsam gtan dang*/ bzlas pa bya zhing*/ tho rangs chu 'khyor ba brgya rtsa brgyad byin la/ bya rog gi sgra mi grag pa dang chu'i nang du zhugs te bzlas pa byed pa de'i nor dang 'byor pa mi zad par 'gyur ro/ / yang na gser la sogs pa'i snod la bsu dhā ra gnod sbyin mo dang bcas pa dang snod gnyis pa la bcom ldan 'das dzam+bha la gnod sbyin rnams kyis yongs su bskor ba bris nas kha sbyor du byas te mnyes par byas na grub pa chen po brgyad kyang ster bar 'gyur na dngos grub gzhan lta ci smos/ zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar na pho la ma ṇi bha drā sogs shar nas phyogs dang*/ kī li ma li la sogs pa bzhi phyogs bral la dgod pa dang*/ mo la'ang dang po bzhi dang*/ phyi ma bzhi ste sngar dang 'dra bar gsungs la/ rgyud sde 'di rnams su g.yon du bskor ba'i rnam gzhag cig kyang med pas g.yas bskor dang*/

phyogs shar nas mgo brtsam pa bzhin du mtshams me nas rtsom pa sha stag yin pas cho ga la sogs pa'i 'gros mi gsal ba rnams skabs kyi rgyud gang yin gyi ji lta ba bzhin sbyar dgos kyi rgyud sde gong ma bde mchog la sogs pa'i rgya bkab tu mi rung ste/ 'di bya rgyud rigs drug gi nang nas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rigs/ de la yang de bzhin gshegs pa dang pad+ma dang rdo rje'i rigs gsum gyi nang nas dang po/ de la yang rigs kyi gtso bo dang*/ 'khor lo bsgyur ba dang*/ yum dang gtsug tor dang*/ sems dpa' sems ma la sogs mang ba'i nang nas/ 'khor lo bsgyur ba 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud dang sbrel bar bya ba 'jam dpal dpa' bo gcig sgrub tu grags pa yin pa'i phyir/ spyir dzam+bha la cig nyid yo ga dang bla med kyi'ang gsang 'dus dang*| dus 'khor sogs nas bshad pa'i sgrub thabs mang bas skabs 'dir ni dpa' bo gcig sgrub la rten dgos te/ bya spyod kyi gzungs thams cad kyi 'og tu bla med kyi lha sngags bzhag tu mi rung ba'i phyir/ des na/ rten gang yin gyi zhabs dang tshad pa'i gser dang dngul zangs kyi 'dab ma'am shog bu la sogs pa pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i lte ba la gtso bo yab yum dang*/ 'dab ma la rgyud las bshad pa de rnams ji skad brjod pa bzhin go rim dang yi ge 'bru len ma nor ba shin tu dag par bris pa'i swā hā'i gong du dha na bru hī shrī bhu ti pūṣ+ti ku ru zhes pa'i spel tshig rgyas bsdus gang shong dang*/ mi shong na sngags rkyang pa de yang mi shong na yab dgu la dzaṃ dang*/ yum dgu la baṃ yig rkyang pa'ang rung ste gtso bo yab yum dbu nub bstan dang zhal shar bstan/ stod smad kun tu 'khor thams cad dbu phyir bstan dang zhal nang bstan du byas la bri zhing shong na phyi ru mu khyud gsum rim gyi nang ma la dbyangs gsal bar ma la ye dharmā phyi ma la rdo rwa/ de'i mthar me ri'ang rung ste dbyangs gsal ni sngags thams cad kyi gzhi yin la/

ye dharmā ni stod smad kun tu ji ltar mang gin bzang ba'i phyir dang*/ rdo rwa me ri ni rgyud kyi lha thams cad kyi thun mong ba yin pa'i phyir/ shong na lha bris pa'i thugs kar sngags bris na yang rung la/ lha ni yab thams cad g.yas bi dza pū ra dang g.yon ne'u li/ yum thams cad g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon rin po che'i snye ma 'dzin pa gsus pa che ba la sogs pa gnod sbyin gyi nyams dang ldan pa'o// legs par grub nas kha sbyar gyi bar du rin po che dang gos dar dang 'bru dang zas la sogs pa bzang rgu gang shong bcugasbrang dang ka ra dang mar gyis kha sbyar te/ pho 'khor steng dang mo 'khor 'ogagatso bo yab yum gyi mdun rten gyi mdun phyogs su 'ong bar byas la dar dmar pos dril nas ma nor bar gzhug go / gsum pa rtsod pa spang pa ni/ 'o na bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas yig mgo phyir bstan mdzad kyang lho byang go ldog ste 'khor la byed pa man ngag yin zhes gsungs pa dang*/ bla ma dam pas kyang steng ma g.yon skor dang 'khor gyi yig mgo nang bstan mdzad pa ma yin nam zhe na/ phyi mas de ltar mdzad pa'i yig cha ma mthong la/ mdzad du chug kyang sla ste/ de dag bstan 'dzin gyi gtso bo yin mod kyi/ dus dang bstan pa'i sku chags kyi dbang gis yi ger bris pa la 'khrul pa cung zad srid pas gang gsung khas mi blang ngo*/ /rgyu mtshan ni sngar rgyas par bshad pa'i rig pa rnams la lan gsung rgyu med pa'i phyir dang*/ rje btsun gong ma rnams dang yang 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ yang kha cig steng 'khor g.yon skor dgos te/ kak+ṇi'i dkyil 'khor sogs la sa rgyan dang gnam rgyan gyi khyad par gyis lho byang go ldog dgos shing*/ lag len la yang byed pa mang gi khyod kyis bshad pa ni byed mkhan nyung bas mi 'thad do ce na/ dgos pa gang gis bsgrub/ rgyud rgya gzhung gi lung ni med/ man ngag yin gsung ba la ni lan brjod zin to//

rigs pas grub te/ ma slog na 'jig rten spyi'i lho byang dang mi mthun pa'i phyir zhe na/ lho byang la sogs pa'i phyogs thams cad ltos 'jog kho na yin la/ 'dir ltos sa'i gtso bo ni/ rang rang gi dkyil 'khor ba'i gtso bo yin gyi 'jig rten spyi dang bstun don med cing gtso bo'i g.yas g.yon log pa'i skyon 'byung bas mi 'thad do/ /mi 'byung ste/ gtso bo'i dbu shar la bstan no ce na/ rgyab mdun log pas kyang de las kyang skyon che'o zhes brjod zin to/ /mang bas nyung ba sun 'byin pa mi nus te/ dag pa dang ma dag pa gnyis phyi ma ches mang ba'i phyir te/ shes pa dang mi shes pa gnyis phyi ma shin tu mang ba'i phyir ro// gsum pa ni/ de ltar gnam rgyan gyi dkyil 'khor yang sa rgyan ji bzhin du bris nas| steng du sbyar bar byas pa yin gyis mngon sum ltar snang gi 'khrul pa skyed par mi bya'o/ /de ltar byas na lho byang 'chugs pa dang*/ 'khor gyi lha rnams bzhengs pa'i tshe dbu mthur du 'phyang bar 'gyur bas sa rgyan dang mi 'dra bar gnam rgyan la ni 'khor gyi lha rnams dbu gang bstan du bya dgos so zhes kha cig lag len la yang byed do/ /de la ni de lta na gnam rgyan gyi dkyil 'khor la mda' yab nang du bri dgos par 'gyur te/ sa rgyan ltar bris na bslangs pa'i tshe bre kha sbub pa lta bur 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /'dod na/ de 'dra'i dkyil 'khor ni rdo rje 'chang gis kyang mi mkhyen no/ /skyon med de/ bar snang de nyid bsgyur nas ldang bas so zhe na/ rten gyen du langs nas kyang brten pa mgo mthur du 'phyangs pa yong bar gzigs pa de 'dra'i blos slong ngo mtshar che'o/ de ltar legs par grub nas rab gnas kyi cho ga dge legs rgya mtshor ji skad bshad pa'i cho ga thun mong dang thun mong min pa skabs su gang bab kyi rab gnas legs par bya'o// de ltar na rab tu gnas bya'i rten gyi sgrub tshul mdo tsam brjod pa ste/

shin tu rgyas par ni rdo rje slob dpon chen po dag gis spyod yul yin pas da ltar gyi slob dpon rnams kyi yul las 'das shing yi ge yang mang kyi dwaugs pas ma spros so| |phan bde'i rtsa ba thub bstan nam mkha'i ngogs/ /rten gsum dge 'dun sde dang bcas pa yi/ /nyi zla rgyu skar snang bas khyab phyir du/ /de dag sgrub tshul dpal 'byor rgya mtsho 'di/ /shes bya'i gnas kun lhag ma'i mun bral bar/ /ji bzhin snang byed blo gros rta ljang can/ /phan bde'i pad tshal che cher rgyas 'dod pa'i/ /skad gnyis smra ba pradzñā rat+nas sbyar/ /'dis mtshon dge ba'i gzi 'od stong 'bar bas/ /mi shes mun pa'i dgra las rnam rgyal te/ /chos kyi rgyal srid gling la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /chos kyi rgyal po nyi mar bdag gyur cig/myos ldan gyi lo snron gyi zla ba'i bcu dgu mchod pa la grub bo// //sarba bha wan+tu//
